shing slar bslang ste/ /mchod rten de la dad par bgyid pa ni/ /de ltar bslang ba de yang de yi rgyu/ /de bzhin chos kyi mchod rten na ba yang / /chos la gus par rang gi sha dang ni/ /khrag gis byug pa dag gis thar bar 1bgyis/ / 'dzam bu'i nagling du bdag gis mar me bltam/ /dge slong 'di ni 'chi ba'i dus bgyis na/ / 'dzam bu'i 3gleng du ting 'dzin sgra yang ni/ /sems can rnams la rtag tu nub par 'gyur/ /'di gsos pas ni ting 'dzin rnams kyang 'thob / /dge slong 'di ni 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs/ /'jig rten ldongs 4pa dag la mig sbyin pa/ /'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang gti mug la/ /sman pa'i rgyal po chen po gso bar bgyid/ /chen por gyur par rtag tu sems gnas te/ /de yi spyod pa dag ni tshad mi rnyed/ /nges pa'i don dang tshig la shin tu bslabs/ /pha rol rgol ba kun gyis zil mi non5/ /chos smra ba 6la rim gro mchog bgyis pasal/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag ni stong du yang / /bdag la phyir yang 7log ltung 'jigs ma mchis/ /bud med dngos por bdag ni phyis mi 'gyur / /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ gzhon nu de lta bas na shin tu dka' ba ‘ spyad pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i chos 'di thos nas chos smra ba na ba la sman shin tu dkon pas rim gro bya ba la brtson zhing bdag gi sha dang khrag gis kyang rim gror byas te/ tha na sor mo gcig tsam sbyin pas kyang 'gro ba'i chos kyi mchod rten la rim gror 1bya'o//de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa la sngon byung ba'i gtam nges par bstan pa 'di rgya cher tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis yang dag par rab tu bstan to/ /gang gis gang gā'i bye 1 snyed sangs rgyas zhing //55wa 298

wa —wa wa— wa ——wa ———— ————— ————————————— ————wa —————— ————wa wa ——————wa —wa wa — —— — ——— ———rin chen bkang nas 'dren la phul ba 1bas/ /gang gis rkang pa'i sor mo gcig byin na/ /de bas bsod nams mchog 'di bye brag 'phags/ /bu mo de ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas/ /sangs rgyas bye ba stong dag mthong bar gyur/ /kun gyi /bstan pa la yang rab byung nas/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba'i mchog 'di rab tu bzung / /rkang gnyis gtso bo de dag thams cad ni/ /yongs su mya ngan 'das pa 3phyi dus na/ /de ni rtag par rab tu byung gyur te/ /bde gshegs sras mo kun nas nyon mongs med/ /mar me mdzad pa de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /bstan pa la yang tshangs par spyod pa spyad/ /der yang bud med dngos po bsgyur nas su/ /de tshe de ni dge slong chos smrar 4gyur/ /rtag tu dam pa'i chos ni yongs 'dzin pa/ /mi dbang ye shes stobs ni byams pa yin/ /mar me mdzad ni chos smra der gyur te/ /de tshe nga ni rgyal po'i bu mor gyur/ /lha mo sngon gyi snag gi gnyen gyur pa/ /mi dbang ye shes stobs kyi phyir 'brang zhing / /rgyal po'i rmi lam du yang ston pa ni/ /mi 'khrugs spyad 5pa spyod tshe der gyur to/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni rab tu 'dod pa'i phyir/ /g.yo sgyu thams cad yongs su spangs nas su/ /bdag gi sha dag dang ni khrag gis kyang / /chos smra ba la ngas kyang rim gror sgyu byas/ /dge slong na ba na tshas gzir ba de/ /gang dag mthong nas de tshe ngus pa yang / /phyir mi ldog par de dag rab gyur te/ /log par ltung ba'i sar ni yong 7ma song / /de dag 8rtag tu mig kyang na ba med/ /klad 9pa'i nad med rna ba'i nad med de/ /sna yi nad med lce yi nad kyang med/ /so yang na bar nams kyang 1 ma gyur to/ /dge slong na ba de tshe sus bsnyen pa/ /de dag rtag tu kun nas mdzes par gyur/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis bsod 5༷diX 9/rgya

— — ———— —————— ———— — ————————————————wa wa wa wa ————wa wa —pa'i 1mtshan/ /dpal dang gzi brjid dag gis lus kyang 'bar/ /de dag nga yi bstan la rab 2byung nas/ /rab tu 'jig dus byang chub dam pa 'di/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod kyang bzung nas ni/ /sangs rgyas bye ba stong dag mthong bar 'gyur/ /byang chub mchog 'di legs par bzung nas su/ /rtag tu ri mo byas shing bcang byas na/ /de dag skye dgu'i don chen byas nas ni/ /mi yi gtso bo mi 'khrugs mthong bar 'gyur/ /de dag spyod pa bla med 'di thos nas//dga' ba zang zing med pa 'phags pa 'thob/ /de dag bdag gi sngon spyad thos nas ni/ /sangs rgyas dag la mchod pa rgya cher byed/ /dge slong mkhas pa tshul khrims ldan mthong nas/ /g.yo med par ni rtag tu bsnyen par bya/ /zhe sdang tha ba dag kyang rnam spangs te/ /dge slong chos smra rtag tu bsnyen par gyis/ /gnod sems khro ba dag kyang rnam spangs 3la/ /nga yi sras po chos skyong mchod par gyis / /bskal pa bye ba mang por long ba dang / /log par ltung zhing sdug bsngal gyur ta re/ /gcig la gcig kyang gnod sems byas na ni/ /de la tshul khrims thos 5pa skyob mi nus/ /bsam gtan mi skyob dgon gnas skyob mi nus/ /rdokā ༵ mi skyob sangs rgyas mchod pa min / /ye shes ldan gyi le'u ste sum cu rtsa de nas yang tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 7nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 55—300

wadasakyis bdag—la skabs 1phyen ——— ——bye rtebyerterno'as— dhe shāsne rno ger+shar+shar+shatā bye dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o / /de skad ces gsol pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /de'i phyir kun dga' bo bdag gi stan la 'dug la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang dris pa de dang de lung bstan pas ngas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /zhus pa lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das bdag la skabs phye'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag la skabs phye'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo 2bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar stan la 'dug nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi rgyu gang gi rkyen gyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byang chub sems dpa'i spyad 8pa mtha' yas pa spyod pa dag lag pa bcad pa dang / rkang pa bcad pa dang / rna ba bcad pa dang / sna bcad pa dang / mig dbyung ba dang / mgo bcad pa dang lus bcad pa dang yan lag bcad par gyur/ sdug bsngal rnam pa sna tshogs gzhan dag kyang myong bar gyur cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las kyang nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu gang lags rkyen gang lags/de skad ces gsol pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'di yang dag par sgrub pa na/ ngas sdug bsngal ji snyed myong bar ca55—301

gyur pa khyod kyis shes shing de dag dran na ci'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di yongs su 'dri bar sems/ kun dga' bo 'di lta ste dper na 'di la skyes bu la la zhig rkang pa nas spyi bo'i bar du 'bar bar gyur te/ rab tu 'bar zhing me lce gcig tu gyur pa de la skyes bu la la zhig der nye bar 'ongs te/ 'di skad du kye skyes bu tshur shog /lus la me 'bar ba ma zhi bar 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang phrad cing ldan par rtses shig /dga' bar gyis shig /yongs su spyod cig ces zer na/ kun dga' bo 'di ji snyam du sems/ skyes bu de lus la me 'bar ba ma zhi bar 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang phrad cing ldan par gyur te/ rtse ba dang /dga' ba dang / yongs su spyod par byed dam1/ kun dga' bos gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo yongs su brtag pa bzung ste/ skyes bu de lus la me 'bar ba ma zhi bar 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang phrad cing ldan par gyur te rtse ba dang dga' ba dang yongs su spyod pa byed du zin kyang de bzhin gshegs pa sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na sems can rnams ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bar gyur cing dbul ba dag mthong nas yid bde ba'am sems dga' ba nam byung ngo //kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na tshul khrims ma nyams pa dang tshul khrims ma zhig pa dang / tshul khrims ca'adren ma ma yin pa dang / tshul khrims sra srer ma gyur pa dang / tshul khrims ma 'bags pa dang tshul khrims ma g.yos pa dang tshul khrims ma blangs 5pa dang / tshul khrims ma 'khrugs pa dang / tshul khrims mi yang ba dang / tshul khrims gzhan la ston pa ma yin pa dang / tshul khrims mi slu 55wa 302

ba dang / tshul khrims drang ba dang / tshul khrims dam bcas 1pa bzhin du byed pa dang / tshul khrims sems can rnams la phan 'dogs napa yin te/ de lta bu'i tshul khrims dang ldan dpar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyad pa mtha' yas pa spyod pa de dag ni lag pa bcad pas yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur/ rkang pa bcad pas yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur / rna ba bcad pa dang sna bcad pas yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur/mig phyung ba dang mgo bcad pas yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur / lus dang yan lag bcad pas yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur te/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyang mi myong la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o// //'phags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdo/ bam po bcu gnyis pa/ kun dga' bo rnam grangs 'dis kyang 'di ltar rig par bya ste/ kun dga' bo sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa grangs med pa bas kyang ches 5grangs med pa/tshad med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gzhal du med pa/ mtshungs pa med par gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang ske/ mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i pad ma'i zla ba rnam 6par dag pa mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /yang de'i tshe de'i dus 7na rin po che'i pad ma'i zla ba rnam par dag pa namangon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 55wa 303

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi che'i tshad ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur gyur to/ /nyi ma thams cad la nyin re zhing yang sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dgu nyasangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog pa la bkod do/ /rab tu bkod cing yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas sems can grangs med dpag 2tu med pa rnams zag pa zad pa dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod do/ /rab tu bkod cing yongs su mya ngan las 'das na sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa la bkod 8de yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur to/ /kun dga' bo de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i pad ma'i zla ba rnam par dag pa mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lnga brgya pa tha ma la dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ba'i dus kyi tshe dam pa'i chos rab tu 'jig par 'gyur ba na/ kun dga' bo rgyal po dpa' bas byin zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/rgyal po dpa' bas byin de la btsun mo'i 'khor ni bud med brgyad khri 4ribazhi stong yod do/ /bu 5ni stong yod do/ /bu mo ni lnga brgya yod do/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyi 6rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan zhes bya ba yangs shing rgya che la sgo bzhi yod pa/ stegs bu dang sgo khangam dang rta babs dang skar khung dang pu shu nadang khang pa dang khang pa brtsegs 9pa dang / skyed mos tshal gyis brgyan cing rnam par bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ lha'i gnas bzhin snang ba/ sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa'i gnas su gyur pa zhig yod do / /kun dga' bo de'i tshe de'i dus na mdo sde 'di lta bu dag ni skye bo mang pos 55—304

smad cing skye bo mang pos spangs te/ skye bo mang po dang mi 'phrod cing skye bo mang pos bor bar gyur te/ 'jigs pa chen po mi bzad pa'i dus su gyur pa/gtse ba mang zhing char ches pa'i dus kyi tshe char mi 'bab pa'i dus kyi tshe/ dus ma yin par char 'bab pa'i dus kyi tshe/ sbrul 'byung ba'i dus kyi tshe/ lce 'bab pa'i dus kyi tshe/ mu ge 'byung ba'i dus kyi tshe/ log par lta ba'i dus kyi tshe/yang dag pa ma yin par lta ba'i dus kyi tshe/ mu stegs can gyi gsang sngags yongs su tshol ba'i dus kyi tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub rab tu 'jig 1par 'gyur ba'i dus kyi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' bdun stong grong dang grong khyer dang ske/ grong rdal dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang ljongs nas bskrad nas de dag chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes dang lhan cig kun du bzang po zhes bya ba'i nags khrod der rten na cing gnas te dge slong de dag la gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ston to/ /kun dga' bo nags khrod de yang dus thams cad du snang ba'i me tog sna tshogs dang / snye ma dang / 'khri 5shing dang ske/ 'bras bu dag dang ldan pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang ca'adra ba/shing sna tshogs kyis gang zhing sa'i gzhi yang gzugs dang kha dog du ma dang sa bon dang myu gu thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ brag dang rdo ba sna tshogs mdzes shing dri ma med pa/ yangs shing mtho ba dang gser gyi ri dag gis rimadzes par byas shing sdug pa/ grub pa'i rig sngags 'chang dang dri za'am skyes bu'am drang srong dang mi 'am ci dag gnas pa/ byadamatshigazugs dang kha dog che zhing rnam pa sna tshogs mang po gnas pa/ sangs rgyas du ma bzhugs bzhugs pa/ dga' tshal dang 'dra ba kun tu bzang zhing rnal 'byor dang 'thun pa'i nags tshal dam pa kun tu 55—305

bzang po de na 1byang chub sems dpa' de dag rnal 'byor la rjes su brtson zhing gnas par gyur to/ /yang kun dga' bo chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes de gcig pu dben par /song nas/ nang du yang dag 'jog la zhugs te/ lha'i mig rnam par dag pa mi'i las 'das pas bltas na/ byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig mang po dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs nas 'dir skyes te/de dag gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 3'di mnyan pa rnyed na ni bla na med pa layang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ gal te gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan pa ma rnyed na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir ldog pa dag mthong ngo / /de nas chos smra ba 5me tog zla mdzes dran zhing shes bzhin du ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po ga la yod pa der song ste phyin yinas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu dag 7kho bo ni 'gro'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong 'dab nadang / ljongs 9dang ske/ yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du song la sems can rnams la chos bstan par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de dag gis chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod nags khrod 'di nas 1 grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong 'dab 11dang / ljongs dang ske/ yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du 'gro ba 'di 12ni kho bo cag 'dod pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge slong dang dge slong ma dang ske/ dge bsnyen dang dge bsnyen ma lhag pa'i nga rgyal can mang po dam pa'i chos spong ba dag byung ba'i dus la bab kyis15/ de dag tshe dang ldan pa'i srog 55wa 306

rtertewa byebye(wa byerte ༵༵ ——— —————rternorngorterno pa ni— rnye bye ༵༵༵ ṅge/ byed bzhin bzarngo la 1blta na sdug ste/ dang po'i lang tsho dang ldan zhing / na tshod dar la bab ste/ mdog ni gser btso ma bzang po 'dra/ dpral ba ni dung dang zla ba dang me tog kun da'i kha dog lta bu'i mdzod spus brgyan/ spa dang gtsug tor ni mthon mthing 2la lcang lor 3'khyil pa yin pas rgyal po'am rgyal po'i 4blon po'am/ de dang 'dra ba gzhan dag kyang phrag dog dang 'jungs pas non pa'i sems kyis khyod kyi srog bcad 5na ma legs so/ /de nas chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de la 'di skad du gal te kho bos bdag nyid bsrung ba byas na kho bos 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bstan pa bsrung 6bar mi 'gyur rol/ /zhes zer nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bdag tu 'du shes 'di la gnas nas su/ /bstan pa 'di la bsrung 7bar yong mi nus/ /mi bzad phyi dus bde bar nagashegs pa yi/ /byang chub bstan pa bkod pa chen po yin/ /gang gis bdag tu 'du shes kun spangs shing / /sems can 'di dang gang zag smra gnas dang / /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro rnams dang / /reg bya spong ba de ni bstan pa bsrung / /bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i bye snyed du/ / dang ba'i 9sems kyis zas dang skom rnams dang / /gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba 1 yis/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas/ /gang gis dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par 'gyur ba'i tshe / /nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa/ /bsod nams 'di ni de bas bye brag 'phags/ /skyes bu khyu 1 mchog gi ni dam pa'i chos/ /'jig par 'gyur 55—307

tshe gang dag btang snyoms sgom/ /de yis rgyal ba bkur sti byas ma yin/ /'dren pa dag la ri mor des ma byas/ /khyed bde rang gi don gyis la/ /bdag nyid rab tu bsrung bar gyis/ /khyed ni rtag tu byams gnas shing / /'dul ba 'di la bag yod gyis/ /ma 'dres dag gtsang7dri med pa/ /tshul khrims drangasapor bsrung bar gyis/ /gang gis tshul khrims dri ma med/ /sangs rgyas bsngags pa bsrungs dupa ni/ /de yis ji snyed sngon byung ba/ /bde gshegs thams cad ri mor byas/ /de yis thams ④cad bskyabs pa yin/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams byang chub bkod/ /sngon gyi sangs rgyas dag gis bstod pa yi/ /tshul khrims dri ma med pa sus bsrungs pa/ /de dag gis ni sems can mang po yang sems can dmyal ba dang ni sdig las drangs/ /chos mchog rin chen sbyin pa sbyin par gyis / /bzod pa dag kyang rtag tu bsrung gyis la/ /dgon par gnas shing ting 'dzin mkhas pa dang / /'jam zhing mnyen pa dag kyang bsgom par gyis/ /rnam pa kun tu rtsod 5)pa ma byed par/ /spyad pa zhi mchog 'di la rnam par spyod/ /bdag ni sems can rnams kyang bskyab ⑥pa'i phyir/ /grong dang rgyal po'i pho brang 'gro bar bya/ /blo gros che 'chang sems can dam pa'i mchog /drang srong de ni 'gro bar byas pa dang / /kha cig rkang pa la yang 'ju bar byed/ /snying rje bar yang ngu zhing mchi ma zag /mkhas pa blo gros chen ( po ma bzhud par/ /sgra 'jam yid du 'ong zhing mdzes pa yi/ /shing 3)'di rnams la gzigs shing rtogs 6)pa mdzod/ /bdag nyid bsrung ba mdzod la ma bzhud cig /sngon gyi stobs bcu 'dren pa de dag kyang / /dbang po zhi zhing shin tu des pa rnams/ /nags tshal brag dang ri yi rtser gshegs nas/ /byang chub dam pa dag ni thugs su chud/ /55—308

byang chub rgyur yang spyod pa dam pa spyad/ /de dag bsod nams ye shes mchog dang ldan/ /de dag rjes slobs nags khrod gnas par mdzod/ /brtul zhugs bzang po 'di nas ma bzhud cig /lus ni shin tu mdzes pa'i mtshan gyis brgyan / /khyod kyi skra yang mthon mthing71)kha dog ste/ /gser gyi kha dog dang 'dra 'od byed pa/ /sa 'di kun kyang rab tu snang bar gyur/ /khyod kyi mdzod spu bzhin gyi smin mtshams na/ /shin tu mdzes pa dung dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /rgyal po na)dag kyang de bzhin srid kyi phyir/ /phrag dog bskyed nas /khyod kyi lus bshig 'gyur / /de nas chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes kyis 4byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de la tshigs su bcad pas smras pa/ ji snyed sngon gyi bde gshegs byung ba ni/ /thams cad mkhyen cing zag pa zad pa rnams/ /de dag thams cad 'jig rten don mdzad de/ /srid pa gsum du byang chub dam pa rtogs/ /spyad pa'i dam pa byang chub rgyu spyad de/ /de dag bsod nams ye shes mchog dang ldan / /de yi rjes bslabs 5byang chub sems dpa' yang / /sems can khrag khrig rnams kyi skyabs byed 'dod/ /drang srong mkhas la 6kun gyis bskor byas te / /rkang pa la yang phyag 'tshal shugs phyung nas/ /mi bzad snying rje bar ni sgra 'byin cing / /nyam thag mi bde cho nges 'bebs 7par byed/ /kha cig rab tu 'gyel cing brgyal nas su/ /sa la lhung ba sā la 8bcad 'gyel 9bzhin/ /'on kyang drang srong sems can don 'dod pa/ /bsod nams bsags pas de las phyir mi ldog10 /drang srong chos gos lhung bzed thogs nas chas/ /ji ltar seng ge ral pa can dag bzhin/ /de ni chos kyi rang bzhin gnas pas na/ /de la yon tan nyes par bya ba med/ /'jig rten 'dir na 1 nags khrod bdag gnas 55—309

pas / /sems can ngan song song na 1ma legs shes/ /de ni sems can bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /grong khyer pho brang mchog tu song bar gyur/ /de nas chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal nadang / ljongs dang ske/ yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang du 'ongs nas sems can rnams la chos bstan te/ de'i snga dro der 'ongs nas srog chags /khrag khrig phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa la bkod do/ /da dung rgyal po'i pho brang der ma phyin pas de mthar 4gyis rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan pa der phyin pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan pa der nye bar song ste/ shing blag sha dang sā la'i drung du 'dug go / /de de'i nub mo 'das 5pa dang rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs par gyur te/ zhugs nas srog chags bye ba khrag khrig phrag sum cu rtsa drug sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par bkod kyang da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas sol/ /de zas gcad pa bcad nas rgyal 6po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song ste/'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so/ /de de'i nub mo 'das nas de snga dro gnyis pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs nas srog chags bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa gsum sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par bkod de da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so/ /de zas gnyis pa gcad 7pa bcad nas rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song ste/ 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas sol/ /de de'i nub mo 'das nanas de snga dro gsum pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor 55—310

————— — —wa ——wa ——— —— ————————————————————— —— ——————————wa wa— — ——— — —— —————————————————rin chen ldan du zhugs nas srog chags bye ba brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu sangs rgyas kyi chos las phyir mi ldog par bkod de da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so//de zas gsum pa gcad pa bcad nas rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song nas 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so/ /de de'i nub mo 'das nas de snga dro bzhi pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen 1ldan du zhugs nas srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bkod de da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas sol/ /de zas bzhi pa gcad pa bcad nas rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song nas 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so/ /de de'i nub mo 'das nas de snga dro lnga pa la btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du song nas bud med brgyad khri bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bkod do/ /grong khyer de nas kyang sems can grangs med dpag tu med pa dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bkod de da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so/ /de nyi ma lnga zas gcad pa bcad nas rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song nas 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so//de de'i nub mo 'das nas de 2snga dro drug pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs nas rgyal po'i bu stong bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par bkod de da dung zas kyi bya ba ma byas so/ 55wa/༷ ༵ ma

drug zas gcad pa bcad nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan nas byung ste / bcom ldan 'das kyi sen mo'i mchod rten gang na yod pa der song nas 'greng bzhin du nyin mtshan 'das par byas so/ /de de'i nub mo 'das nas de snga dro bdun pa la rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs pa dang rgyal po dpa' bas byin skyed mos tshal du 'gro ba mthong ste/ gser gyi shing rta la ngos ni dngul mda' ni sbrul gyi snying po'i tsan dan/ 'khor lo ni bai drarā1/ gdugs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba dang / rin po 2che'i shing rta sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ shing rta'i mda' la dar gyis dkyis shing ras bcos bu phrugs kyis g.yogs pa de bu mo gzhon nu brgyad brgyas rin po che'i tha gus btags shing 'dren te/ de dag byad bzhin bzang zhing mdzes pa/ blta na sdug pa/ kha dog bzang po rgyas pa'i mchog dang ldan pa/ byis pa rnams dga' bar byed cing tshim par byed pa ste/ mkhas pa rnams la ni ma yin no/ /rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu brgyad khri bzhi stong yang zhabs 'bring mthon 4dman du 'gro'o/ /bram ze shing sā la chen po lta bu brgyad khri bzhi stong yang zhabs 'bring mthon gdaman du 'gro'o/ /khyim bdag shing sā la chen po lta bu brgyad khri bzhi stong yang zhabs 'bring mthon tshodaman du 'gro'o/ /rgyal po'i bu mo lnga brgya yang rin po che'i khyogs kyi nang du zhugs 7nas mdun thog thag tu 'gro ste/de dag gis dge slong de mthong ma thag tu bla na med pa 8yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /btsun mo'i 'khor brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad kyang 9dge slong de mthong ma thag tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /skye bo'i tshogs chen po de dag kyang 55—312

nor bu dang gdu bu rnams bgrol te lham rnams bzhag 1nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ dge slong de ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te phyag 2'tshal zhing 'khod do/ /de nas bu mo gzhon nu de dag kyang sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dag gis bskul bas khyogs de dag las babs nas nor bu dang gdu bu dag bgrol te lham rnams bzhag nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas dge slong de ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar te tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /dge slong 'di ni snebyon pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma lta bur thams cad du/ /'di dag rab tu snang bar bgyis/ /skye bo'i 4tshigs kyang 'dun par gyur/ /'dod chags zhe snang rgyun bcad cing / /gti mug dag kyang bsal bar gyur/ /de tshe zhe snang khro ba dang / /phrag dog thams cad bcad par gyur/ /rgyal po dpa' bas byin pa yi / / zhabs 'bring 5/sras la sogs pa yang / /su yang rgyal po mi lta ste/ /su yang zhabs 'bring 6mi bgyid do/ /ji ltar zla ba nya ba ni/ /skar ma dag gis bskor 7ba bzhin/ /rgyal po'i bu yi namadun bdar bas/ /dge slong 'di yang mdzes par gyur/ /ji ltar gser gzugs ri mo dag /mkhas pas ri mor bris pa dang / /sā la'i rgyal po rgyas pa ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong mdzes par gyur/ /mthu chen brgya byin lha yi dbang po ni/ /grong khyer 'jig 9pa bdag po mig stong ldan / /ri rab spyi la sum cu rtsa gsum dbang / /de bzhin dge slong byon pa 'di 1 yang mdzes/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten tshangs pa gnas pa 'dra/ /rab 'phrul lha yi bu ni lha dbang bzhin/ /'dod khams 'thab bral mchog gi lha bzhin du/ /dge slong byon pa 'di yang de bzhin mdzes/ /nyi ma bzhin du bar 55—313

snang lhan der bgyis/ /'od zer stong ldan mun nag rab tu sel/ /phyogs rnams kun tu snang bar bgyid pa ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong byon pa mdzes par gyur / /bskal pa mtha' yas rgya cher sbyin pa byin/ /tshul khrims ma 'dres rtag tu bsrung ba bgyis/ /bzod pa mtshungs med 'jig rten kun tu bsgoms/ /de ni mtshan gyis brgyan cing 'di ltar mdzes/ /'phags pa'i skye bos rab bstod brtson 'grus bskyed/ /bsam gtan bzhi yang zhum med sems kyis bsnyen/ /nyon mongs dra ba bsal cing shes rab bskyed/ /de phyir dge slong 'jig rten kun tu gda'/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa mtshungs med sems can snying po ste/ /dpa' bo 'das pas chos mchog dag kyang rab tu bshad/ /ma 'ongs dus dang de bzhin 1da ltar byung ba yi/ /chos kyi rgyal po dbang brnyes rnams kyi 2sras de lags / /dge slong khyod ni mi rtag nam yang ma gyur cig /gzugs ni 'di ltar 'jig rten kun na rab tu lhan/ /gzi brjid che zhing dbyapas sgra shin tu 3snyan par gda'/ /rgyal po'i gzi brjid shin tu lham me snang mi bgyid/ /chos 'di ji ltar khyod bdag nyid kyis rab rtogs shing / /sangs rgyas dag gis bka' stsal 'jig rten kun tu rgyu/ /de bzhin bdag cag bud med dngos po kun spangs te/ /bdag cag thams cad dge slong 'di bzhin 'gyur bar bgyi/ /de dag thams cad sor bcu thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /tshigs bcad 'di dag smras te gos rnams 'thor bar byed/ /gser gyi phreng ba dang ni rin chen do shal dang ske/ /rna ba'i rgyan 4dang mgul gyi rgyan dag rnam mang 'thor/ /ji ltar 'khor los sgyur ci ba'i rgyal po dag /stobs ldan sa 'di kun la rnam par lta / /sras su 'du shes dag ni nye bar 'jog /gling rnams bzhi po 'di dag kun tu 55—314

'gro / /rgyal rigs dang ni tshong dpon bram ze dang / /khyim bdag mkhar gyi rgyal po bdag gi 1mi/ /de dag gcig la lhag par sdug pa med/ /thams cad la yang byams pa mnyam par bskyed/ /de bzhin dge slong des pa 'di yang ni/ /gzungs dang dbang rnams la ni shin tu bslabs/ /byang chub yan lag stobs dang dbang po dang / /yan lag brgyad ldan lam yang rnam par 'byed/ /mtshan mo zla ba skar tshogs dbus na yang / /ji ltar rab tu mdzes par snang ba bzhin / /ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'char ba'i tshe/ /gzi brjid ldan zhing rnam par snang bgyid bzhin/ /dbang po zhi zhing stobs bcu ldan pa yi/ /sangs rgyas nges pa kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gis ni bsngags pa bskal pa brgyas / /zad par byed nus skyes bu su yang med/ /bskal pa bye ba stong phrag mang por ni/ /yon tan brjod kyang zad pa yong med de/ /'jig rten rab mchog gi ni spu gcig kyang / /bsngags pa dag ni zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /des ni mtshungs med 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /ye shes dag gi gnas kyang shin tu bstanam/ /zhib cing rdul bral chos rnams bshad pa mdzad/ /de ni gang na'ang snang bar 'gyur ba med/ /dge sbyong dang ni bram ze lha dang klu/ /lha min bdud dang tshangs par bcas la sogs/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyis / /rgya mtsho dag ni zad napar yong mi nus/ /gang gis thugs sras 'di 'dra mnga' ba yi/ /sman rgyal mtshungs med rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshigs bcad 'di dag smras nas de yi tshe/ /rgyal po'i bu mo gzhon nu thams cad dga'//gser dang gser phye dag kyang 'thor bar byed/ /gos rnams kyang ni rab tu 'ding cabar byed/ /gtsug gi nor bu do 5shal mdzes pa dag /rin thang bye ba 55—315

phrag ni brgya ri bas/ /dge slong de la nyamangon par g.yogs nas ni/ /dga' nas byang chub phyir yang rab tu zhugs/ /de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma btsun mo'i 'khor 'di dag ni log par zhugs te skye bo'i tshogs kyang log go snyam mo/ /skye bo de dag kyang nor bu dang gdu bu bkrol lham bzhag nas gos phrag pa gcig tu bgos te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas dge slong de ga 2la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo //dge slong de byad gzugs bzang ba tsam du rgyal po dpa' bas byin byad bzhin mi bzang ske/ de tsam du blta na sdug pa ma yin/ de tsam du mdzes pa ma yin te/de rgyal po'i srid kyi phyir 4shin tu sdangs ru par gyur to/ /dge slong de'i gzugs kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa mthong nas shin tu khros so/ /dge slong de rgyal po'i lam na 'dug pa'i mig tu rdul song ba dang de 'di snyam du sems te/ dge slong 'dis chags pa'i sems kyis nga'i btsun mo'i 'khor la bltas te/ 'dis mig gis kyang brda byas so/ /de 'di snyam du sems te/ da 6dge slong 'di la srog gcod par byed pa su yod snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyi zhabs 'bring 7du bu stong 'brang ba de dag bos nas gzhon nu dag dge slong 'di srog dang phrol cig ces byas na / gzhon nu de dag rgyal po dpa' bas byin la slar zlog go/ /dge slong de'i phyir de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gi bu dag kyang bka' mi nyan te/ bdag gcig pu gnyis su med par bzhag na da 9dge slong 'di srog dang bral bar byed pa su yod snyam mo/ /de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin la gsod pa'i gshed ma dga' byed ces bya ba gtum po btsam pa 1 med pa ma rungs pa zhig yod pa de rgyal po'i 1lam na rgyal po dpa' bas byin dang ha cang 55—316

kā rngo bye rte/nge /zhe ṅgewa rno kārdog go/ — ———— ༵༵ —the dpashā shā shā —bye rno gyis rje ge~Xng nas dga' mgu yi 1rangs te/ rab tu dga' ba dang mos pa dang yid bde ba skyes nas de sems 'di snyam du sems te/ dga' byed 'dis dge slong 'di srog dang dbral bar byed snyam mo/ /de nas gsod pa'i gshed ma dga' byed rgyal po dpa' bas byin gang na 'dug pa der 'ongs pa dang dga' byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyod bya dga' cher sbyin na dga' byed khyod dge slong 'di srog dang bral bar byed nus sam/ dga' byed kyis smras pa/ lha shin tu rngo thogs so2/ /bka' bzhin 'tshal/ da 3dge slong 'di srog dang dbral bar 'tshal lo/ /rgyal pos smras pa/ dga' byed de'i phyir de'i dus la dbab 4par shes na mtshon rnon po thogs la dge slong 'di'i lag pa dang rkang pa chod cig /rna ba dang sna yang chod cig /'dis chags pa'i sems kyis nga'i btsun mo'i 'khor la bltas kyis 5de'i phyir 'di'i mig kyang skam pas phyung shig 6ces byas so/ /de nas gsod pa'i gshed ma dga' byed kyis de'i tshe ral gri rnon po thogs nas dge slong de'i lag pa dang rkang pa bcad do/ /rna ba dang sna yang bcad do/ /mig gnyis kyang phyung ngo / /de nas dge slong de'i mgo dang rna ba dang rkang lag bcad pa las 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma yang byung / 'o ma'i rgyun du ma yang byung ste/ phyogs bcur bskor nas slar yang dge slong de'i lus kyi nang du nub bo / /bcad cing gtubs pa'i 'phro nas dpal be'u dang bkra shis dang 'khor lo la sogs pa nang nas byung ste skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kun tu snang ngo / /de nas rgyal po de skye bo'i tshogs chen po dang dong nas skye bo'i tshogs chen po des dge slong de lam na bcad gtubs shing 'dug pa mthong nas/ de 55—317

dag sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ste/ ngo mtshar du gyur nas ngu zhing cho nges btab ste smre 1sngags bton nas phyir yang rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan par song ngo / /de nas rgyal po dpal dbas byin zhag bdun 'das pa dang skyed mos tshal mchog na 'dug pa mi dga'/ mi rtse yongs su mi spyod de / skyed mos tshal nas de logs 5nas zhag bdun 'das pa dang rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rin chen ldan du zhugs pa dang des dge slong de rgyal po'i lam du bor ba shi nas zhag bdun lon yang lus kyi mdog ma gyur pa mthong nas de 'di snyam du sems te/dge slong 'di'i lus kyi mdog ma gyur pa las bltas na dge slong 'di ni gdon mi za bar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin te / bdag gis sems can dmyal ba chen por skye bar 'gyur ba'i sdig pa'i las byas kyis 6bdag ni myur du sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur ro zhes de de ltar sems pa na/ steng gi bar snang las lha'i bu brgyad khris sgra skad dbyangs gcig tu smras pa/ rgyal po chen po 'di ni de bzhin te/ khyod ji skad zer ba ltar dge slong 'di ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin no zhes zer ro/ /bar snang las lha dag gi sgra thos nas de shin tu 'jigs shing skrag nas bag tsha zhing spu zing zhes byed de 'gyod par gyur to / /de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ste 'gyod par gyur pas de'i tshe cho nge cher btab nas tshig 'di skad zer ro/ /rgyal po'i srid dang rgyal po'i pho 8brang dang / /nor bu rin chen mu tig gser dbyig spang / /bdag nyid mtshon thogs bdag nyid 'chi bar bya/ /bdag ni 9byis pa'i blo can las ngan ldan/ /dge slong me tog zla mdzes 'dir byung ba/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis 55—318

mtshan gyi go bgos te/ /snang bar byed cing rgyal po'i pho brang 1'ongs/ /zla ba nya tshe skar ma'i rgyal po bzhin/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod ngan pas bdag dkrugs 5te / /rab tu dga' bar bud med tshogs rnams dang / /shing rta'i nang du zhugs te de nas dong / /rgyal rigs rnams kyis yongs su 'khor bar bskor/ /dge slong dri mchog mig bzang 'di nyid ni/ /'dir byon dge slong de yang mthong nas su/ /bud med tshogs rnams rab tu dgar 3gyur cing / /mos pa skyes nas gser gyi phreng ba gtor/ /thams cad sor bcu'i thal mo sbyar byas nas / /tshigs bcad dbyangs kyis dge slong de la bstod/ /rgyal po yi ni klu 4yi dbyangs sgra rnams/ /de dag thams cad rab tu zhi bar gyur/ /de yang shing rta'i nang du zhugs nas ni/ /rgyal rigs rnams kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sras mchog mthu che ba/ /dge slong dri mchog mig bzang 'dir byon na/ /bdag gi sems ni rab tu ngan gyur te/ /dge slong rgyal po'i pho brang 'jug 5pa'i tshe/ /bud med tshogs chen dga' bar lta mthong nas/ /rmongs pas de la phrag dog khro ba bskyed/ /phyogs bzhi kun tu snang bar bgyis nepa ni/ /zla ba sgra gcan zin thar mdzes pa bzhin/ /dge slong rgyal po'i pho brang 'jug mthong nas/ /bud med tshogs rnams dga' zhing sgra yang 'byin/ /bdag gis der ni gtum po'i 7tshig smras te/ /bu stong dag la nga 8nyid khyod song la/ /dge slong 'di ni dum bu dum bur gyis/ /'di ni nga yi dgra mchog ma rungs pa/ /gzhon nu thams cad mnyen zhing tshul ldan te/ /bdag la phan sems dge slong de la 'dud/ /rgyal po 'di 'dra'i bka' bzhin bgyir mi rung / /de tshe bdag ni mya ngan non par gyur/ /dge slong shin tu tshul khrims mchog ldan 55—319

pa / /byams ldan pha bzhin zhugs pa mthong nas ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i sems kyis gsod du btang / /phyi dus bdag ni lhung nas mnar med sreg /dga' byed de ni rgyal po'i lam 'dir gnas/ /ma rungs las bgyid mi la sdug bsngal skyed/ /bdag gi bka' 1bzhin de 'drar des 2bgyis te/ /me tog phreng brgyus 'dra ba'i dge slong gtubs/ /nags mchog kun tu bzang po dga' ba na/ /bya yis gang zhing me tog dri zhim rgyas/ /de na dge slong tshogs gzhan rab mang ba/ /bu gcig pa 3ni ma dang bral ba bzhin/ /dge slong bzhengs la nags su gnas par mdzod/ /mi yi don kyang shin tu rgya cher bgyis/ /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor 'dir byon pa'i tshe/ /dge slong shin tu snying rjer ngu zhing tshol//lag pa g.yas pas me tog rgyal mtshan thogs/ /g.yon pa yis kyang blta sdug camadzes pa gzhan/ /lam yang sbyangs shing gos kyis khebs par g.yogs/ /dge slong bzhengs la chos mchog bshad pa mdzod/ /rgyal po'i khab 'dir khyod zhugs ring lon kyang / /dge slong rab tu snying rjer ngu zhing tshol/ /rgyal ba mchog gi bstan pa 'jig pa'i tshe/ /khyod kyi srog gi bar chad 'gyur du dogs/ /ji ltar skyes bu mthu chen la la dag /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rtag tu sgra grags pa/ /srid gsum 'di kun thams cad zil mnan nas/ /g.yang sa chen por mchongs te sar lhung ltar/ /de bzhin dge slong mtshan mchog rab brgyan pa/ /byad 5bzhin bzang po sa 'dir 'gyel bar gyur/ /me tog zla mdzes zhe sdang gtum med pa/ /bdag gi 2sdig pa'i sems kyis dum bur rlags7/ /me tog zla mdzes bkrongs nas sar lhung ba/ /chos smra 'di ni mthong nas myur bar yang / /dge slong thams cad sdug bsngal gzir 8gyur te/ /mi dga' skyes 'gyur de 55—320

bzhin sems mi bde/ /me tog zla mdzes ri yi rgyal po ltar/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyi go bgos te/ /phreng ba brgyus pa bud med thogs pa 'dra/ /'dir ni dum bu dum bur rnam par bcad/ /bdag gis dngos sdig shin tu mi bzad bgyis / /mgon med mnar med gshin rje'i yul du mchimi/ /'dir yang dge slong dum bur rlags 2pa yis/ /bdag ni 3sangs rgyas rnams dang ring bas ring / /bdag gis shin tu las ngan bgyis pas na/ /bu dang gnyen bshes tshogs rnams skyabs mi 'gyur/ /blon po dang ni zhabs 'bring 4bkrabs pa yang / /de dag dmyal bar bdag song skyabs mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas 'das dang de bzhin ma byon dang / /phyogs bcu dag na gang su bzhugs pa yi/ /ded dpon stobs bcu nyon mongs med pa rnams/ /rdo rje stug sra sku mnga'i skyabs su mchi / /der ni dge slong dum bur byas mthong nas/ /lha rnams rab tu snying rje cho nges 'debs/ /de dag der song dge 'dun go bar byas/ /me tog zla mdzes rgyal po'i khab 'dir bsad/ /chos smra ba ni mkhas shing rtogs pa de/ /mthu chen phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rab tu grags/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs 5la gnas pa de/ /me tog zla mdzes rgyal po'i khab 'dir bsad/ /bskal pa mtha' yas sbyin pa sna tshogs byin/ /tshul khrims mi g.yo skyon med gang srung zhing / /'jig rten kun tu mtshungs med bzod sgom 6pa/ /me tog zla kyimadzes rgyal po'i khab 'dir bsad/ /bskal pa mtha' yas rtag tu brtson ldan zhing / /zhum med sems kyis bsam gtan bzhi la sgoman/ /nyon mongs 'joms pa'i shes rab gang bsten pa/ /me tog zla mdzes rgyal po'i khab 'dir bsad / /lus la phangs pa thams cad rab spangs shing / /de bzhin srog la ma haṃ 5—321

chags gyur nas ni/ /kun tu bzang po'i nags nas babs 1nas su/ /me tog zla mdzes rgyal po'i khab 'dir bsad/ /lha yi cho nge'i snying rje thos nas ni/ /dge slong de kun shin tu sdug bsngal nas/ /me tog zla mdzes nyes med bsad pa la / /lta ba'i phyir yang thams cad grong du lhags/ /des pa de dag rgyal po'i khab 'ongs nas/ /dge slong dum bu 2dum bur byas mthong ste/ /nyam /thag skad kyis mi bzad cho nges 'debs/ /de dag thams cad brgyal canas sa la 'gyel / /dge slong dge 'dun rgyal po de la smra/ /tshul khrims skyon med shin tu bsdams pa yi/ /dge slong 'dis ni nyes pa ci zhig byas/ /'di ni sngon gyi skye ba bsam yas dran/ /'di ni ye shes gzungs dbang pha rol phyin/ /'di ni 'dus byas 'di dag stong par shes/ /'di ni 'gro ba dag la mtshan med ston/ /'di ni smon lam 'du shes thams cad spangs/ /'di ni yid 'ong 57snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 6'byin/ /'di ni nges shing dbang po rab tu zhi/ /'di ni sngon gyi gnas kyi pha rol phyin/ /'jig rten thams cad las kyang mngon par 'phags/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rang byung ye shes kyis/ /khyu mchog gyur cing 'jig rten ri mor 7byas/ /dag cing rab rib med pa'i mig gis lta/ /byams pa dang ni snying rje shin tu che/ /'dod pa ngan cing btsog 8la sdug bsngal skyed/ /mtho ris rnam par ma rung byed pa ste/ /'dod pa bsnyen na rna ba med par 'gyur/ /mi dag shes rab dang yang bral bar 'gyur/ /mi 9rnams 'dod pa dag ni bsnyen byas na/ /long bar 'gyur zhing pha dang ma yang gsod/ /'dod pa bsnyen byas tshul khrims ldan pa gsod1 / /de bas mi yis 'dod pa rnam par spang ske/ /rgyal pos 'dod pa dag ni bsnyen byas na/ /sa bdag dam pa 'byor pa 55wa 322

'di bor nas/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal rtsub byed sems dmyal nas/ /sems can dmyal ba 'jigs pa chen por 'gro/ /'di 'dra'i dge slong mkhas pa gsod byed de/ /sdig pa'i las rnams rtag tu byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir byang chub zhi ba su 'dod pa/ /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs spang bar bya/ /lus ni sgyu ma gsog dang 'dra ba dang / /de bzhin rna mig sna lce rig nas ni/ /gzugs dang sgra dang de bzhin dri mchog dang / /reg bya chos rnams zhum med sems kyis gtong //sbyin la bslabs shing tshul khrims mnyam 1pa med/ /bzod pa dang ni brtson 'grus de bzhin te/ /bsam gtan sten cing shes rab pha rol song sems can dag gi don kyang rab tu byed/ /'jig rten lha dang mir dbacas thams cad kyang / /byams pas rgyal ba la ni rab tu lta/ /de phyir mig ni mun gnag gtibs gyur kyang / /byang chub zhi ba nyid ni 'tshang rgya 'gyur/ /rta dang bal glang yang thogs 4khri rnams dang / /khyogs dang sngas rnams kyang ni de bzhin te/ /glang po dag dang bzhin dang dgal ba dang / /grong dang yul 'khor dga' ba gtong bar 5byed/ /grong khyer dang ni rgyal srid yongs gtong zhing / /gser dang dngul dang shel dang byi 6ru dang / /de bzhin gnas dang bu dang bu mo dang ske/ /rang gi mgo yang gtong zhing byang chub zhugs/ /me tog dang ni spos dang bdug pa dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan lha yi ba dan 7dang / /rol mo'i cha spyad na sna tshogs thogs nas ni/ /dga' nas mchod pa mtshungs pa med pa byed/ /srid pa dag ni stong par shes nas kyang / /srid pa'i 'gro ba dag la dga' mi byed/ /de phyir stobs bcu mtshan gyis rnam brgyan cing / /phyogs bcu thams cad du yang snang bar byed/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs 9la 55—323

gang gnas pa/ /'dod pa'i khams rnams dang ni gzugs kyi khams/ /gzugs med khams la de dag mi chags te/ /khams gsum dag la snga nas chags pa med/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs 1la gang gnas pa/ /bdag tu 'du shes sems can 'du shes med/ /srog tu 'du shes gang zag 'du shes med / /tshangs par spyod pa ma 'dres rtag tu 2spyad/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs 3la gang gnas pa/ /dngos por 'du shes dngos med 'du shes med/ /bde bar 'du shes mi bder 'du shes med/ / grangs su 'du shes grangs med 'du shes med/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs pal gang gnas pa/ /yod par 'du shes med par 'du shes med/ /bud med 'du shes skyes par 'du shes med / /grong gi 'du shes grong khyer 'du shes med/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa/ /yul 'khor 'du shes grong 'dab 6'du shes med/ /'dod chags 'du shes 'dod bral 'du shes med/ /zhe snang 'du shes snang bral 'du shes med/ /gti mug 'du shes rmongs bral 'du shes med/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa/ /nga rgyal nga rgyal bral ba'i 'du shes med / /ma rig ma rig ma yin 'du shes med/ /lta dang lta ba ma yin 'du shes medam/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas pa/ /de dag dbang po stobs la mi chags te/ /byang chub yan lag bsam gtan chags pa med/ /khams gsum nyes pa thams cad rab tu spong 7/ /'dod chags chags med zhe sdang gtum pa med/ /gti mug rmongs med rtag tu g.yo med 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas stobs bcu mthong nas bkur sti byed/ /blo gros ldan pa mtho ris smon mi byed / /su dag gzhan las chos mchog thos nas ni/ /de la nam yang nem nur 55—324

zlurmedzā ———'brumar shermermedabazhinadangazhengadag —bye wa rnorngorngo bcad gzhan gyi 1blo yang shes/ /mdza' ba byas na rjes su chags pa skye/ /de yang nyon mongs pa ni chen po yin/ /zhe sdang byas na khong khro skye bar 'gyur/ /dgra dang 'jigs pa sdig pa rnams kyang 'byung / /'di gnyis rab tu rnam par spang byas te/ /blo gros ldan pa dag ni byang chub zhugs/ /de dag mi yi khyu mchog stobs bcur ni/ /'jig rten du yang mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nang dang phyi rol dag kyang rnam spangs te/ /chos kyi ngo bo 5nyid la rab gnas shing ske/ /tshul khrims phung po dag kyang rnam par sbyangs/ /ral ba med cing ma 'dres skyon yang med/ /nam yang de dag gi ni tshul khrims dag /'phags shing 'dres pa dag tu mi 'gyur te/ /mtha' 'di dag ni gnyis po yongs spangs nas / /blo gros 'chang ba byang chub zhi rtogs ca'agyur/ /de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis dge slong gi dge 'dun las chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes kyi yon tan bye brag chen po yangs shing rgya che ba thos nas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi dga' nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po la tshigs su bcad pas slar smras pa/ nags khrod stug po kun tu bzang po ni/ /sdong po chen pos gang zhing 'bras bus mdzes/ /dus kun skye ba me tog sdug pas brgyan/ /sna tshogs tha dad bya rnams sgra yang 'byin/ /gser gyi ri yang mdzes shing mtho bas brgyan/ /mi 'am ci yi glu dbyangs snyan pa dang / /rol mo shin tu thabs ldan yid 'ong grag /grub pa'i bu mo rtag tu gar yang byed/ /nags de lha yi dga' ba'i tshal bzhin te/ /gzugs bzang gzugs 'bar ba yi shing gis dkrigs/ /me tog rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad bkram/ /ud pal pad mos ci brgyan cing chu yang 55—325

'babaske/ /'di 'dra ba yi nags mchog nyams dga' ba/ /drang srong rtag tu gnas par 'thun pa dag /bor nas sems can don dang phan bzhed pas/ /sdig pa'i phung po bdag drung grong du byon/ /de ltar chos smra yon tan 'chang ba 'di / /me tog zla mdzes grong khyer 'dir byon te/ /byon nas sdig pa bgyid pa bdag gis bkrongs/ /'di bkrongs pas ni bdag kyang dmyal bar ltung / /byang chub sems dpa'i thugs rje'i 1stobs ldan gang / /dpa' bo sems can phan phyir 'jig rten spyod/ /de dag sdig bgyid bdag gi 2skyabs mdzod cig /byang chub sems dpa' de skyabs bdag mchi'o/ /gang yang rang rgyal dag ni gnyis pa dang / /gang gzhan nyan thos rdzu 'phrul ldan pa ste/ /zag pa zad cing tha ma'i lus 'dzin pa/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal mnar med mchi ba skyobs/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/de lta bas na kun dga' bo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos lus dang srog la ma chags par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo lus dang srog la chags pa'i sems can rnams mi dge ba'i las mngon par 'du byed par 'gyur ro/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ rtag tu rul ba'i lus 'di dang / /srog kyang g.yo zhing dbang med de/ /rmi lam sgyu ma 'dra ba la/ /sems can gang dag chags pa ni/ /shin tu ma rungs las byas nas/ /gti mug dbang song de dag ni/ /sems can dmyal ba mi bzad par/ /mi mkhas bdud kyi gzhol bas 5song / /dbu ba rdos dzo'adra'i lus dang ni/ /chu yi chu bur 'dra srog la/ /mi gang chags par mi byed pa/ /de dag 'gro ba mchog tu 'gro/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun 55wa 326

dga' bo de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting nge 'dzin 'di 'dod pa dang / myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas lus dang srog la mi lta bar 1byas te/ mgo dang gos la me 'bar ba bzhin du brtson 'grus brtsams pas sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed de dper na 2dben pa na bde bar gnas pa dang dgon pa dang / nags khrod spangs te grong dang grong khyer dang ske/ grong rdal dang ljongs 5dang yul 'khor dang rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang ri khrod rnams su zhugs te/ ci nas sems can de dag nyan thos kyi byang chub dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las 4phyir mi ldog pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba de lta de lta bur sems can rnams la chos bstan par bya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la sngon byung ba'i gtam bstan pa 'di nyid rgya cher tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis rgyas par rab tu bstan to/ /ngas sngon spyad 5pa dag ni spyod pa na/ /de tshe rgyal po dpa' bas byin par gyur/ /rgyal po'i pho brang rin chen ldan zhes bya/ /skyed mos tshal gyi sar ni byung bar gyur / /shing rtar tshozhugs pas de tshe dge slong mthong / /kun nas mdzes shing blta na sdug pa ste/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis snyematshan gyi go bgos pa/ /phyogs rnams thams cad du yang snang bar byed/ /me tog zla mdzes phyogs su grags pa ste/ /snying rje gnas pa phan zhing snying brtse ba/ /dpal dang gzi brjid dag gis mdzes pa ni/ /sems can rnams la brtse phyir grong du 'ongs/ /nga 8ni gzugs kyang de tsam mi phod pas/ /de la nga yang 'jungs pa ma rungs skyes/ /'dod la 55—327

chags shing srid la bcings pas na/ /'di ni bdag gi srid las skyod snyam ste/ /nga yi bu rnams stong du tshang 1ba yang / /shing rtar zhugs shing zhabs 'bring mthon 2dman 'gro/ /cod pan dang ni sna tshogs rgyan 3gyis brgyan/ /sum cu dbang phyir lha yi bu 'brang bzhin/ /de na nga yi bu mo lnga brgya dag /nor bu thogs shing lham gyon blta na sdug /mgo rgyan dang ni lhab lhub rgyan gyis spud / /de dag gser gyi dra bas shing rta 'dren/ /nga yi bud med dag ni brgyad khri yang //gzugs mdzes shin tu blta na sdug pa dag /shing rtar zhugs pas dge slong de mthong ste/ /ri rab bzhin du gzugs bzang dpal 'bar ba/ /mthong nas de dag phar yang 'du shes bskyed/ /byang chub dam pa mchog tu sems skyes te/ /de tshe tshangs pa'i spyod par yang dag btsud/ /yid du 'ong ba'i rgyan rnams de la gtor5te/ /de tshe nga 6ni phrag dog skyes par gyur ’/ /gnod sems zhe sdang tha ba mi bzad de/ /dbang phyug 8rgyags pas bu la 'di skad smras/ /mdun na 'dug pa'i dge slong bsad par gyis/ /gzhon nu de dag nga yi tshig thos nas/ /shin tu sdug bsngal yid kyang mi dgar gyur/ /yab cig de skad kyi ni tshig ma gsung / /dge slong 'di 'dra bdag cag mi 'gums so/ /bskal pa bye ba gang gā'i bye snyed du / /bdag cag lus dang yan lag bcad gtubs kyang / /dge slong 'di ni 'gums par mi bgyid de/ /'di ltar bdag cag byang chub sems skyes so/ /rgyal po de tshe bu yi tshig thos nas/ /khros te gsod pa'i gshed ma 'bangs la smrasal/ /nga yi btsun mo'i ༷mdun na 'dug pa yi/ /dge slong 'di ni myur du sod de phul/ /de nas gsod pa'i gshed ma phyi bzhin 'ongs/ /shin tu gtum sems dga' byed snying rje med/ /'bru mar ngar 1 btags ral gri thogs nas 55wa 328

—wa wa ——————————————————— ————wa ——wa ———————————— ———— —wa ————————wa —————————su / /de 1yis dge slong dum bu brgyad du byas/ /de yi lus dang yan lag 2bcad pa las/ /khrag kyang mi zag 'od zer stong byung ste/ /bcad pa'i 'phro na 3dpal be'u 'khor lo dag /mtshan rnams de yi lus 4kyi nang na yod/ /shin tu ma rungs las ni byas nas gsu/ /skyed mos tshal du de yi mod la byung / /dge slong me tog zla mdzes 6dran nas ni/ /de 7yi rtsed mo dga' bar ma gyur ton/ /rings pa'i gzugs su myur zhing mgyogs par ni/ /de nas bdag gi rgyal po'i pho brang song / /gang du dge slong dum bu brgyad byas pa/ /sa phyogs der ni shing rtar zhugs nas phyin / /lha rnams khrag khrig mang po bar snang la/ /cho nges 'debs pa'i sgra dag des thos te/ /rgyal po khyod kyis mi dge sdig mang bgyis / /shi 'phos nas ni mnar med mi bder 'gro/ /rgyal po des ni lha yi sgra thos nas/ /shin tu sdug bsngal mi dga' sems skrag gyur/ /bdag gis me tog zla mdzes bkrongs pa ni/ /bdag gis sdig pa mi bzad mang po bgyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes mtha' yas ldan/ /sangs rgyas mi yi khyu mchog sras po gang / /dbang po bsrungs 1 shing des pa zhi ba'i yid/ /de ni 'dod pa'i don phyir bdag gis bgrongs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos rnams gang 'dzin cing ske/ /zad pa'i dus la dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /'jig rten kun tu chos kyi sgron ma mdzad/ /de ni 'dod pa'i don phyir bdag gis bkrongs/ /'jig rten kun na sman pa'i rgyal po gang / /sems can na ba rtag tu gso byed cing / /bdud rtsi dag 1 gis bkru sman gtong ba yi/ /dge slong bdag gis 'dod pa'i don phyir bkrongs/ /zhib cing zab la zhi ba blta dka' ba'i/ /chos rnams skye dgu dag la gang 'chad cing / /byang chub snying po mchog kyang gang sto/5 pya/329/de

——— —— ———wa —wa ————————— ——— wa wa ———wa ni 'dod pa'i don phyir bdag gis bgrongs/ /'dren pa rnams kyi chos kyi mdzod 'dzin cing / /'jig rten ldongs 1pa'i sgron mar gyur pa ste/ /gzungs dang mdo sde'i rgyal po gang 'dzin pa/ /de ni ci slad bdag gis 'dod phyir bkrongs/ /nyon mongs med cing rnam dag ye shes can/ /zhi ba rab zhi rtag tu mnyam gzhag pa / /'dod pas ldongs 2pas bdag gis deng bkrongs te/ /des ni shin tu ma rungs dmyal bar ltung / /sangs rgyas gang dag 'das dang de bzhin ma byon dang ske/ /mi yi dam pa rgyal ba gang yang bzhugs pa ni/ /bsngags pa mtha' yas ༷yon tan rgya mtsho ldan pa rnams/ /de dag kun la thal mo sbyar te skyabs su maḥpha//gas pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdo/ bam po bcu gsum pa/ de nas rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes bsad de shi ba'i lus kyi mdog ma gyur par sa la 'gyel cing 'dug pa mthong nas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ste 'gyod cing myos par gyur nas de'i tshe cho nges rab tu cher btab po / /chos smra ba me tog zla mdzes de la yang 'di lta bur yang dag pa'i yon tan gyis bstod pa dang snying rje dang ldan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di 5dag smras so/ /kun tu bzang por 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyis/ /khyod la rnam pa mang po bsgo ba bgyis/ /khyod kyi srog gi bar chad byung nga re6/ /rin chen ldan par rgyal po'i khab ma bzhud/ /khyod kyis dge slong dge 'dun tshig ma bzung / /mgon po grong khyer du ni ci slad byon/ /khyod ni gang gi don du byon pa yi/ /don de sgron ma mdzad pa mdzad du gsol/ /lha rdzas myu gu sna tshogs brgyan pa'i sa/ /gzugs bzang gzugs 'bar shing ljon mang pos dkrigs / /grub pa'i rig 55wa 330

'dzin gnod sbyin mchog gis bsrungs/ /lha rnams zhugs shing bya rgyal sgra yang sgrog /kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas rtag bzhugs pa/ /nags tshal dam pa 1dga' ba bor nas ni/ /bgyi ba gang phyir khyod ni 'dir byon pa/ /des pa bgyi ba de deng bdag la gsungs/ /khyod kyi tshig thos nas ni bka' bzhin bgyi/ /sangs rgyas sras po bzhengs la bka' 465 cig /kye ma da ni ci dbagyi lha yi lha/ /bdag ni mgon med khyod kyi skyabs su mchi/ /gcig pu seng ge ri dgas rgyal po ltar / /dge slong dge 'dun mchog gi khyu bor nas/ /sems can mtha' yas pa la thugs brtse'i daphyir/ /rang gi srog kyang btang ste 'dir byon na/ /'dod chags zil non shin tu 'jungs pa yis/ /bdag gis dpa' bo dum bu dum bur bcad/ /'di ni dge slong cadage 'dun mtha' dag kyang / /khyod la lta bar pho brang ma lhags par/ /bdag ni 'jigs skrag 5khyod la ci gsol pa/ /bde 6bar gsol ba gcig ni mdzad par 'os7/ /me tog zla mdzes mi 'jigs bdag stsol la/ /nya dus zla ba nya 'drar bzhengs su gsol/ /sems can gtso bo bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /chos smra khyod ni zhe sdang rnam par grol/ /de ring bdag la sna gcig gnang bar mdzod/ /nyi ma bzhin du snang mdzad bzhengs 8su gsol/ /chos smra mchog ni bdag gis bkrongs bgyis te/ /sdig pa ma legs bdag gis deng bgyis pa/ /'di nas —'chi 'phos mi bzad dmyal bar skye / /bdag la de yi skyabs su 'gyur ba med/ /nyon mongs byed pa sdig sems ci ru rung / /rgyags pas khengs pa'i rgyal srid ci ru rung / /thams cad spangs te gcig pu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'di nas bdag gis snying ngo/ ci ma blangs/ /'dod chags zhe sdang bcom pa rnam dag chos/ /snyan par gsung ba bdag thul 55—331

thugs rje can/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gcig sun 'byin mi mdzad pa/ /me tog zla mdzes bdag gis ci phyir bkrongs/ /kye ma bzod dang dka' thub nor phyug brtul zhugs bzang / /kye ma gzugs dang des pa dag gi 1yon tan ldan/ /kye ma g.yo med dpal stug spros 2pa mi mnga' ba/ /bdag cag 3bor nas khyod ni gang du bzhud par mdzad/ /'phags pa khyod kyi lus dang yan lag bcad pa nate/ /'o ma rab tu zag cing 'od zer stong dag byung / /'jig rten 'di dag thams cad shin tu ngo mtshar gyur/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i rang bzhin 'dren pa bzhengs su gsol/ /kye ma me tog zla ba dul 4ba thugs rje can/ /kye ma byams dang snying rje'i phung po ri bo tshur/ /kye ma chos rnams zab mo shin tu ston pa'i mchog /lha khyod bzhengs shig bdag la thugs brtser mdzad du gsol/ /kye ma zla ba nya zhal tshur spyon cig /kye ma sa bcu legs gnas tshur spyon cig /kye ma dpa' bo stobs bcu mngon 'phags pa/ /tshe la khyod dbang bdag po gang du bzhudam/ /kye ma dpa' bo tshur spyon bdag la gsungs/ /khyod kyis yun ring 5bzod pa bsgoms tshopa dang / /brtson 'grus thugs rje de dag gang du mchis/ /byams pa chen po bzhengs la snyegasung phyung zhig /kye ma shin tu mchod 'os lha yi lha / /chos smra cang mi gsung bar ci slad bzhugs/ /mkhas pa bzhengs la bdag gi khyim du bzhud/ /bud med tshogs la khyod kyis chos ston cig /lha khyod lus ni gcad / par mi nus te/ /lha dang lha min gnod sbyin srin pos kyang / /khyod kyi lha yi lus 'di mi shigs kyis 0/ /mkhas pa khyod deng sgyu dag ma mdzad cig /lha khyod sgyu mdzad bzhugs pa ga la gda'/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgyu ma mi mdzes so/ /sgyu ma thams cad spongs la bzhengs su gsol/ /55—332

rterno —chen— rten /me grong du chos shod ci/ ————————bye —bye — 'a bye/shā shā d+me ste/ zla mdzes tshur / /kye ma khams gsum 'dod chags bral ba tshur/ /kye ma pha ma lta bu 'dren pa 1tshur/ /bdag gi sems dmyal sgo ni bcad 2du gsol/ /ngan song skyes pa rnams kyi rten dang dpung / /srog chags mnar med chen por lhung 3ba yi/ /skyabs mdzad me tog zla mdzes tshur spyon cig /bdag gi bde 'gro'i sgo yang dbye bar gsol/ /mgon po khyod ni dgung bdun bshos ma gsol/ /re shig cadeng bzhengs bdag gi bshos gsol cis /bdag gis rabashos gsol rin chen ldan pa 'dir/ /sems can du ma chos la dgod pa mdzod/ /kye tshom chos mchog rtogs pa bdag gi yab/ /kye ma sems can rnams la khon 7med sems/ /kye ma tshur spyon bdag mdun chos ston cig /kye ma tshur spyon khyod smon myur grub shog /dge slong dge 'dun de ni mgon med gyur/ /kye ma mdongs nashing mi dran mya ngan bgyid/ /sems can snying po khyod ni myur bzhengs la/ /dge slong dge 'dun dbugs kyang dbyung bar mdzod/ /kye ma 'jig rten gsum na sgron gyur pa/ /kye ma tshur spyon kun tu bzang por bzhud/ /kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod bzhud nas ni/ /dge slong dag la phan phyir khyod ston cig /kye kye chos 'dzin yon tan rmad byung che/ /a shad me tog bzhin du rnyed par dka'/ /shes rab thugs rje'i spyan ni dri med pa/ /kye kye dge slong dge 'dun gzigs su gsol / /tshig gi lam dang bral ba'i gzugs de yang / /kye kye dge slong dag la bstan du gsol/ /kye kye zla ba shar ba bzhin du 'dir/ /me tog zla ba de ring bzhengs su gsol/ /kye kye rgyal sras bdag la thugs brtse ba/ /dbugs 'byin mdzad pa ston pa bla na med/ /kye kye mtshon dang dbyug pas btab pa bzod/ /55wa 333

bzod pa'i stobs dang ldan zhing 1rab tu des/ /kye kye me tog zla mdzes thugs rje can/ /rab sbyin 'dren pa khyod ni bzhengs su gsol/ /kye kye khyod ni bzhengs la bdag la yang / /mthong bar dka' ba'i gzungs rnams bshad du gsol / /kye kye 'jig rten kun tu snang mdzad pa/ /shes rab kyi ni sgron ma dam pa'i mchog /kye kye sems can dag gi phan don lan/ /brtson mdzad 'dren pa thugs rje'i stobs bcu ldan/ /kye kye me tog zla mdzes bzhengs su gsol/ /dpa' bo sems can dag gi don mdzad pa/ /kye kye sems can dag ni bye ba dang ske/ /khrag khrig rnams kyang zhi ba'i grong du khod/ /kye kye tshul khrims nor ldan blo gros che/ /mkhas pa bslabs pa'i nor gyis shin tu phyug /kye kye tshul khrims brtul zhugs rab gnas shing / /chos kyi shing gi myu gu mngon par dga'/ /kye kye chos gos ngur smrig kha bsgyur 'chang / /rtag tu mngon par byung la dga' bar mdzad ske/ /kye kye me tog zla ba 5brtul zhugs mchog /rab sbyin dka' thub bzang po khyod bzhengs shig /kye kye dul ba sems can ma dul 'dul/ /rtag par dul ba'i gnas dang rjes su ldan/ /kye kye dul ba rab dul 6rjes su bzhud//zhi ba dbang po rab zhi khong nas des/ /kye kye sems can nyal zhing gnyid log pa / /chos kyi sgra yis 7rtag tu sad par mdzod/ /kye kye sems can bye ba khrag khrig dag /sad par bgyis nas theg pa mchog la khod/ /kye kye sbyin pa yi ni spang leb la/ /brtson 'grus thag gus /sbrel ba'i gru sbyor te/ /kye kye sems can rgya mtsho chen por ni/ /rab tu lhung zhing srid 9pas ded pa rnams/ /kye kye stobs bcu ldan pa me tog mchog /mnyan pa gdos 'dzin mkhas pa bzhengs su gsol / /kye kye shin tu sra ba'i grur yang ni/ /zhugs 1 nas bdag dang de dag 55wa 334

bsgral bar mdzod/ /kye kye sman pa'i dam pa brtul zhugs la/ /shin tu spyad cing rig mdzad sman pa'i mchog /kye kye ye shes rnam grol pha rol phyin/ /dam pa'i chos kyi rtsi dag sbyin mdzad pa/ /kye kye nad ni rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /btab pa'i sems can na ba rnams 1gzigs nas/ /kye kye myur du bzhengs 2la de dag la/ /chos kyi sman rnams shin tu stsal bar mdzod/ /kye kye ye shes sman pa'i rgyal po mchog /mtshungs med ye shes 'phags shing pha rol phyin/ /kye kye nad rnams shin tu gso mdzad cing / /thugs rjes sems can dag gi don kyang mdzadarka/ /kye kye na bar gyur pa'i sems can khams/ /'dod chags nad kyis ma lus bcom pa rnams/ /des ni sems can thams cad bde ba dang / /nad rnams med cing mya ngan 'das par 'gyur/ /kye kye mkhas pa ye shes rgya chen bslabasal/ /chos kyi rnga dag shin tu brdung bar mdzod/ /kye kye 'jig rten gyi ni the tsom dgyi/ /'khri shing thams cad ye shes rgya mtshos chod/ /kye kye legs thos chos rnams 'dzin mdzad pa/ /rdul bral mdo sde bye ba brgya dag kyang / /'khor gyi nang du gdan la rab bzhugs la/ /mi mchog mkhas pa brjod pa mdzad du gsol / /me tog zla ba mtshan mchog brgyan pa kye/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu tshang ba kye/ /dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus lus brgyan kye/ /srid pa'i mtsho rgal laspros med tshur spyon kye/ /srid pa'i btson zirar chud khrol bzhengs shig kye//ye shes mchog rig tshangs pa 'dra ba kye/ /me tog zla ba thugs rje chen po kye/ /byams dang snying 6rje skyed la bzhengs shig kye/ /me tog zla ba khyod la gsol ba 'debs / /dge slong dge 'dun khyod kyis ma dor bar/ /tshur gshegs dge 'dun yongs su bsdu ba mdzod/ /bzhengs la nags khrod der yang gshegs sam 55—335

kye1—/ /me tog zla ba bsam gtan dgyes pa mchog /mdza' dang mi mdza' mtshungs par byams shing phan/ /gzungs la rab tu gnas pa tshur spyon kye/ /ye shes sdong po mtshungs med khyod bzhengs shig /ri rab bzhin du mi g.yo brtan pa kye/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas sems can mnyam yid kye/ /me tog zla ba brtul zhugs rdzogs pa kye/ /bzhengs la shing gi drung du 'tshang rgya mdzodan/ /lha yi rna ba chos kyi mchog 'chang kye/ /lha 3yi mig mkhas ye shes rtogs pa kye/ /bzhengs te bdag la gzigs shig thugs rje can/ /grags pa mtha' yas bdag gi tshig gson kye/ /'jig rten kun la phan dang don mdzad kye/ /me tog 4zla ba shin tu sbyin dgyes kye / /bzhengs la myur du bdag gi re rdzogs mdzod/ /khyod 'dir dum bu dum bur ma bzhugs shig /grong 'dir skyes pa bud med tshogs rnams kyang / /khyod mthong thams cad shing bzhin sa la 'gyel/ /snying skams tsho'agyur ba'i mya ngan rnams kyang 7bgyid/ /thugs rje mchog gi spyan gyis de la gzigs/ /gang gi slad du byams pa bsgoms pa dang / /ye shes shes rab thabs kyi stobs rnams dang / /khyod kyi 8thugs rje btang snyoms dga' ba yangs / /de dag rdzogs mdzod bzhengs shig me tog mdzes/ /lha klu lha min rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / /gnod sbyin srin po mi dang mi 'am ci / /snyim pa me tog bdug pas bkang nas ni/ /thams cad mthong bar dga' nas lhags shing 'khod / /drang srong chen po'i tshig ni deng rtogs te/ /skye 0dgu'i 'dod pa gnod byed gsod pa yin/ /yid kyi nad du 'gyur ba ngan 'gro'i rgyu / /de phyir 'dod pa'i spyod pa spang bar bya/ /dge slong bdag gis bsad pa sdig gi lasal/ /shin tu ma legs mi bde byas pas na/ /bdag ni mi bzad dmyal ba 55—336

zlornorngo mewa ——rte/ —— /bdaṅge —bye gesdo ge~X mgowa /ṣ+ṭha~X zlukhro bye shā med / /bsdosgo ṅge byel po'i srid btang tshangs spyod gzhol/ /spos dang me tog byug pa 2rnams kyis ni/ /mchod pa dam pa rnams kyang rab tu bya/ /shin tu mdzes par mchod rten bdag gis bya/ /bu dang bu mo bud med khyim 3bdag dang / /blon po dang ni tshong 4dpon de dag 5dang / /grong ba dang ni rgyal rigs mang po rnams/ /de dag thams cad la ni ngas bsgo ba/ /a ga ru dang tsan dan 6shug pa dang / /shin tu zhim pa'i spos mchog ci yod pas/ /myur du sgrom gyi snying po'i khyogs chos snyel//dge slong 'di ni bsregs 8pa'i cho ga gyis/ /grong khyer mi kun rgyal po'i tshig thos nas/ /spos mchog dag kyang thogs nas khyogs bcas te/ /spos rab bzang po yid du 'ong las byas/ /der ni dge slong der ‘ yang bcug nas su/ /a ga 1 ru dang tsan dan tsam pa ka /rgya spos spri ka de bzhin pa ta la/ /me tog dang ni phreng ba byug pa dag /shin tu bzang dang 'bru mar dag gis bsregs/ /de yi rus pa sgrom ni byas par gyur/ /dge slong dag gis de yang der bsregs te / /rgyal pos de yi 1 mchod rten byas nas su/ /'di la ngas ni mchod pa bya zhes zer/ /me tog dang ni phreng ba byug pa dang / /gdugs dang ba dan rgyal mtshan thogs nas su/ /rgyal pos der ni sil snyan stong dag dang / /bye ba khrag khrig rnams kyang len du btsud/ /nyi ma gcig la rgyal po dus gsum du/ /dge slong de yi mchod rten de drung du/ /sdig pa sngan cad dacung zad ci byas pa/ /de tshe dus gsum du yang shin tu 'chags/ /lo stong bye ba phrag ni dgu bcu lngar/ /nyes pa byas pa dag kyang rab bshags te/ /phyis kyang tshul khrims dam pa ma ral bsrungs/ /rnam par dag cing gtsang la dri ma med/ /lo stong bye ba phrag ni 55—337

dgu bcu lngar/ /gso sbyong dag kyang de tshe rab gsos te1/ /de ni de tshe bdag gi lus zhig nas/ /mnar med mi bzad par ni de lhung gyur/ /'dod phyir snying rje med pa'i las byas pas/ /sdug bsngal mang po dag kyang myong bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu lnga/ /de tshe de dag bdag gis ma mnyes byas / /lo stong bye ba phrag ni dgu bcu lngar/ /de yi tshe na nga ni long bar gyur/ /bskal pa 2bye ba khrag khrig drug cu gnyis/ /sngan 5chad nga yi mig kyang bcar bar gyur/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig phrag stong dang / /shin tu mang bar nga yi mig phyung phrogs/ /mgo dang rna ba dang ni rkang lag kyang / /bskal pa mtha' yas khrag khrig bcad par gyur/ /bskal pa dag ni bye ba khrag khrig tu/ /mir gyur pa dang skye ba gzhan du yang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dag gis rab gtses shing ske/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba yun ring 5myong bar gyur/ /sdig pa'i las rnams byas pas 'khor ba na/ /yun ring shin tu sdug bsngal myong bar gyur/ /de phyir byang chub zhi ba su 'dod pa/ /srid pa gsum du sdig pa mi bya'o/ /rgyal po mchog gis sngon gyi las bshags kyang / /snga ma'i nyes byas rnams las de ma thar//mi bzad gzugs kyi las rnams sngar byas pas/ /de shi dmyal ba mi bzad mnar med song / /nga yi rna ba de bzhin rkang lag bcad/ /bskal pa mtha' yas mang por sna yang bcad/ /spyod pa spyod tshe mtshon cha dbyug 5thogs nas/ /'debs byed nan gyis nga yi mig kyang phyung / /byang chub phyir ni mgo lag lus bcad dang / /bu dang chung ma mig dang rang gi sha /rkang lag dga' ba'i sems kyis yongs btang yang / /sngon gyi sdig pa'i las ni zad ma gyur/ /kun dga' de ltar bskal pa mtha' yas spyod/ /sangs rgyas dpal stug dpag tu med 55wa 338

pa mthong / /byang chub spyod mchog 'di ni spyod pa na1/ /de tshe sdug bsngal 'di dag sngon myong gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzungs la gang gnas shing / /byams spyod rtag tu mi g.yo mi 'gul ba/ /sangs rgyas rdul sbyangs lha yi lha mchod nas / /de dag nam yang ngan song sar mi 'gro/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis go bgos pa/ /chos rje sangs rgyas bdag 'gyur su 'dod pa/ /tshul khrims ma 'dres g.yo ba med par srungs/ /gzungs la rab gnas chos kyang bstan napar gyis / /nga ni de tshe rgyal po dpas dbyin yin/ /nga yi 4bu rnams phyi dus chos skyong ba/ /me tog zla mdzes pad ma bla ma yin/ /dga' byed de ni zhi ba'i rgyal bar gyur5/ /'jig rten gsum dpa' 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rkang gnyis gtso bor gyur/ /skye dgu dag gi 'don chen mdzad nas ni / /mar me bzhin du 'dren pa mya ngan 'das/ /bud med tshogs dang rgyal rigs mang po dang 7/ /khyim bdag dang ni 8blon po stobs chen dang / /tshong dpon de bzhin grong ba'i 9mkhar gyi rgyal/ /thams cad stobs bcu nyon mongs med par gyur/ /me tog zla mdzes kyi le'u ste sum cu rtsa drug pa'o1 // //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/gzhon nu de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ci nas bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bde bar mngon 2par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod na/ gzhon nu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di mnyan par bya/ gzung bar bya/ kun chub par bya/55—339

bcang bar 1bya/ bklag /par bya/ rab tu gdon par bya/ lung mnod cing kha ton du bya/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i bsgom 3pas mang du bsgom par bya/gzhan la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan par bya'o/ /tshul khrims kyi phung po la yang rab tu gnas par bya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims tshogs gnas shing / /bdag la phan sems spyad pa gang spyod pa / /mngon dga'i sangs rgyas zhing du myur song nas/ /bzod pa des thob chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /de phyir gnod sems med cing kun 'thun gyis/ /thams cad rtag tu yid du ga'ong bar bgyis6/ /dpal stug sangs rgyas dpag med mthong nas ni / /byang chub reg nas chos kyi bdag por 'gyur/ /de phyir phan yon mchog 'di thos nas ni/ /dge slong tshul khrims mchog dang ldan mthong na/ /mkhas pas nagayo med rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ring por 9mi thogs ting 'dzin 'di 'thob 'gyur/ /gal te gter rnams dpag med tshad kyang 1 med/ /rin chen sna bdun nor bus gang gyur pa/ /de bzhin zhing rnams gang gā'i bye ma snyed//nor bu rin po che yis gang ba rnams/ /byang chub sems dpa' 1 sbyin la mos rte pa yis/ /nyin mtshan re rer sbyin pa 'di dag byin/ /de bzhin bskal pa gang gā'i bye ma snyed/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sbyin pa 1 byin pa bas/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang gis ting 'dzin 'di/ /thos nas bde gshegs mdzod mchog 'dzin byed pa/ /bsod nams phung po des ni gang bzung ba/ /sbyin pa de kun de yi char mi phod/ /mi gang rjes su 'thun la dad pa dag /ting 'dzin rdul bral mchog 'di 'dzin pa ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpe med mchog 'di yin/ /55—340

༵ shes shādherdo sdo wa shā ṅge —byerdo ———snyeXṅge washā kāwa — rtedhedherdo sto ba—rtedhe shā se bzung na/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni nor chen 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho chen po bzhin du thos pa'i gter/ /de la bsod nams tshad yod yong mi 'gyur/ /chos kyi mchog rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /shin tu rgyas byas byang chub sems dpar 1brjod/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni su dag ston byed pa/ /de ni nam yang byang chub the tshom /med/ /bsod nams phung po mchog dang gang ldan zhing / /gang la tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /'jig rten slob dpon sangs rgyas rnam par 'dren/ /rang byung thugs rje chen po ma gtogs par/ /de yi 'og tu sems can su dag kyang / /stong chen 'di na bsod nams phung po dang / /mtshungs med bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes kyis/ /mnyam par gyur pa nam yang yong med do/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni thos nas 'dzin pa dang / /klog cing yongs su chub par byed pa dang / /mtshungs med sangs rgyas byang chub tshol ma gtogs/ /de yi ye shes mtshungs pa med par 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni bzung zhing bklags 3pa yis/ /bsod nams phung po ji snyed bsags pa yang / /gzhon nu ji ste chos de gzugs yod na/ /'jig rten khams mang 'dir yang shong lami 'gyur / /gzhon nu de phyir byang chub sems dpa' gang / /'das dang 'byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par 'dod pa yis / /ting 'dzin 'di ni gzung zhing bklag ci par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub 'di yin te/ /gzhon nu nga yi tshig la dad par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brdzun dzogyi tshig mi gsung / /'di 'dra'i sems can brdzun du smra ba med / /sngon gyi bskal pa brgya phrag bsam yas su/ /byang chub spyad pa mchog 55—341

'di rab spyod cing / /ting 'dzin 'di ni yongs su tshol ba'i phyir/ /ngas 1 ni bdag tu lta ba 'dir sbyangs so/ /de phyir chos kyi mdzod 'di mnyan par gyis/ /'di las mdo sde bye ba khrag khrig 'byung / /'di ni bsod nams phung po bsam yas yangs/ /'dis 2ni sangs rgyas ye shes myur du 'thob/ /mkhas pa 'jigs med de dag gang ston pa/ /'di ni mdo sde kun gyi dam pa'i mdo/ /dge ba bsam gyis mi khyab 'byung gnas te/ /chos de rnams la mtha' /thug rnyed mi 'gyur/ /stong chen dag ni bcad cing bshig nas su/ /rdul gyi tshogs rnams bgrang bar nus na yang / /mdo sde brgya phrag bsam yas tshad med pa/ /rgyun mi chad par de stong 4bgrang mi nus/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi sems can thams cad kyi/ /phyi nang rgyu ba'i dbugs ni bgrang nus kyang / /ting 'dzin 'di la gnas nas gang ston pa/ /mdo sde de dag mthar thug nus mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni gang gā'i bye ma snyed/ /'gro ba der yang sems can gang skyes pa / /de dag sems ni bgrang bar nus kyang srid/ /rtag ston mdo sde de dag bgrang mi nus/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i bye ma ci 5yod dang / /klung dang mtshe'u dang gshong gi bye ma dag /bskal pa bye ba dag gis bgrang nus kyang / /de dag 'chad pa'i mdo sde mtha' yas so/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni bye ba mang po na/ /chu yi phung po rtag 'dug ci yod pa/ /brgya tshal skra yi rtse mos bgrang nus kyang / /de yi dbyangs kyi yan lag kun mi 'grangs6/ /gang sngon 'dir ni sems can ci 'byung ba/ /rang gi lus la snying por 'dogs pa rnams/ /bskal pa bye ba mang pos bgrang 7nus kyang / /de dag mdo sde sgrub pa shes mi nus/ /phyogs bcu dag na sems can ci yod pa/ /srog chags kun gyi sgra skad bgrang nus 55—342

kyang ske/ /de dag rtag tu mi 'chad ston pa yi/ /mdo sde de dag bgrang bar yong mi nus/ /chos rnams thams cad bstan par rab shes 1shing / /nges pa'i tshig dang bstan pa tshig don mkhas/ /gtan la bab pa'i yang dag tshul la bslabs/ /blo gros yangs shing rtag dga' shes rab can/ /yangs pa'i don sems rab tu phye ba'i blo/ /bsam dang mi bsam pa yang rtag tu shes/ /dbyangs kyi rang bzhin rgya chen thams cad rig /sgra dbyangs de dag ston kyang chags mi 'gyur/ /thogs med de ni chos smrar brjod pa ste/ /'gro ba kun la ston kyang chags mi 'gyur / /dri nab nges par bstan pa brgya la mkhas/ /de ltar de yis don dam rab tu rtogs/ /mdo sde gcig gis phyogs kyang bye ba snyed/ /bsam gyis mi khyab des ston chags pa med/ /chags med ston pa tshig gi don la mkhas/ /'khor gyi nang du de 'chad chags mi 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin 'di la legs par gang gnas pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' de ni g.yo ba med/ /chos la stobs bskyed bye brag thob pas ni/ /srog chags bye ba mang po'i don de byed/ /ji ltar ri rab mi g.yo mi 'gul te/ /rlung rnams kun gyis 'gul bar mi nus pa/ /de bzhin dge slong chos smra mkhas pa yang / /pha rol rgol ba kun gyis bskyod mi nus / /stong chen gyi ni 'jig rten khams 'di na/ /ri gang mi g.yo bar ni brjod pa rnams/ /de dag rlung gis rab tu bskyod nus kyang / /stong pa'i chos gnas dge slong bskyod mi nus/ /su dag stong pa nyid la rtag brtson pa/ /sangs rgyas gnas su nges pa de yin te/ /gtan la bab pa stong pa'i chos rab shesal/ /de ni rgol ba kun gyis dkrug mi nus/ /phas kyi rgol ba dag gis mi bskyod cing / /smra ba thams cad kyis kyang zil mi non/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di 55wa 343

ni bstan byas na/ /zil gyis mi non smad pa med par 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di ni bshad byas na/ /de yis stong nyid rtogs par khong du chud/ /de ni chos rnams kun la nem nur med/ /ye shes mtha' yas dag la khor mor gnas/ /ting 'dzin 'di ni bzung zhing bklags 1pa na/ /stobs dang byang chub yan lag rnyed mi dka'/ /yang dag rig dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /de la mngon par shes pa rnyed mi dka'/ /mtha' yas ye shes rgyal ba mthong ba yang / /srid par grub pa dag ni rnyed mi dka'/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig bsam mi khyab/ /ting 'dzin 'di 'chang de yis mthong bar 'gyur/ /de ni rgyal ba de dag thams cad las/ /ting 'dzin zhi ba 'di yang thos 'gyur te/ /yang dag rig dang dbang gi pha rol phyin/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog dang ldan par 'gyur/ /stong chen gyi ni 'jig rten khams 'di dag /lha rdzas nor bu rin chen bzang mchog gis/ /'og nas bzung ste srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar/ /nor bu rin chen dag gis gang gyur dang / /zhing yang mtha' yas rnam mang ji snyed pa/ / 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser bkram gang ba kun/ /sa yi 'og nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar//thams cad rgyal ba'i mchog la sbyin pa byin/ /sems can rnam pa mang po ji snyed pa / /bskal pa mtha' yas mang por sbyin pa byin/ /sangs rgyas rnams la khor mor mi chad byin/ /byang chub 'dod phyir byin pa'i sbyin tshogs la/ /dge slong gang dag stong nyid mngon dga' zhing / /stobs bcu la ni thal sbyar phyag 'tshal na / /byang chub sems dpa' stong nyid mngon dga' la/ /sbyin pa'i phung po snga mas char mi 'phodag/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi des de rnyed nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mtshungs med tshol ba'i phyir/ /dad pa rgya cher bskyed nas sbyin pa 55—344

byin /———tshawawa ger+sha ge ba wa shā tsha shā/rja—————————bye rdor+sharjo—)rkyen wa(rme mchog 'di las/ /tshig 1bar+sha'i tshigs bcad sems༄ dga' 'dzin pa yang / /de yi bsod nams phung po bsags pa la/ /sbyin pa de kun brgya yi char mi phod/ /ting 'dzin rdul bral zhi ba ma thos par/ /phan byed byang chub sems dpas sbyin byin kyang / /thos pas sangs rgyas ye shes myur thob ltar/ /de tsam sangs rgyas ye shes myur mi 'thob/ /gang gis zhing rimachog sa 'di thob rinas su/ /rdul bral ting 'dzin stong pa'i rigs 'di ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' dga' bas rtogs byed pa/ /des ni sangs rgyas ye shes myur du 'thob/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi gter rnyed pa / /zhing rnams mtha' yas gang gā'i bye ma snyed5/ /de dag lha dang de bzhin mi rnams kyi/ /nor bu rin po che yis gang bar gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas ting 'dzin 'di thob ste/ /rtag tu chub par byed cing mi ngoms pa6/ /thul bar dka' chi zhing mdzod rnams shin tu mang / /nor yang mang zhing rin chen nor dang ldan/ /ji ltar ting 'dzin rdul bral 'di thob 8nas / /byang chub sems dpa' dga' zhing rangs pa ltar/ /rgyal srid shin tu 'byor cing rgyas thob kyang / /mkhas pa de dag nam yang dgar mi 'gyur/ /de dang de dag sangs 0rgyas kun mkhyen gyi/ /chos rnams rtag tu 'dzin par byed pa yin/ / zad pa'i /mthar thug dus su gyur pa'i tshe/ /chos kyi tshul mchog rgya cher 'dzin par 'gyur/ /chos kyi mdzod 'chang blo gros chen po 'chang / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdzod kyang 'chang ba yin/ /de dang de dag sems can bye stong 2dang / /khrag khrig chos kyi dbyangs 1 kyis mgu bar byed/ /de dag tshul khrims nor ldan blo gros can/ /skyes bu de dag bslabs pa'i nor gyis 5phyug /55—345

de dang de dag tshul khrims brtul 1zhugs gnas/ /mngon dga' chos kyi sdong po'i 2myu gu yin/ /de dag chos gos ngur smrig 3rin chen 'chang / /khyim nas 'byung la rtag tu dga' bar byed/ /de dag sems can phan phyir mnyam pa med//thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rab tu zhugs/ /de dag dul ba sems can ma dul 'dul / /rtag par dul ba'i gnas dang rjes su ldan/ /de dag dul zhing rab dul rjes su song / /zhi ba'i dbang po rab tu zhi ba yin/ /de dag sems can nyal ba gnyid log pa/ /rtag tu chos kyi skad kyis sad par byed/ /sems can dag ni sad par byas nas su/ /rin chen chos bzang mchog la 'god par byed//de dang de dag sbyin pa'i bdag po yin/ /khor 4mor rtag tu gtong la brkyang ba ste / /mkhas pa de dag 'jungs dang 'grogs mi byed/ /gtong ba chen po dag la rtag tu dga'/ /de dag sems can dbul zhing sdug bsngal rnams/ /mthong nas longs spyod kyis kyang tshim par byed/ /de dag sems can bde zhing phan pa'i phyir/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rtag par zhugs/ /de dag ye shes rtag tu bslabs pa ste/ /chos kyi rnga yang rgya cher shin tu rdung / /skye bo kun gyi the tshom 'khri shing gcod/ /rtag par ye shes la yang rab tu zhugs/ /de dag legs thos chos 'dzin rdul bral ba/ /'khor gyi nang du stan la 'dug nas su/ / mkhas pa blo gros 'chang ba de 5dag ni/ /nga do sde bye ba brgya dag rab tu ston/ /de dang de dag mang du thos pa yin/ /thos pa 'dzin pa sangs rgyas chos rnams 'dzin / /chos kyi mdzod rnams shin tu 'dzin byed de/ /thub pa'i chos kyi gter la dga' ba yin/ /de dang de dag shes rab yangs pa yin/ /dga' ba dag kyang rgya cher rtag tu skyed/ /zhib cing 'byung bar 'gyur ba blta dka' ba/ /55wa 346
