pa dang / ye shes 'byung gnas dang / brtson 1pa mi gtong nadang / mthong ba don yod dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa khri nyis stong dang thabs cig 3tu bzhugs so/ /lha'i bu mtshams bzang dang legs par gnas pa'i blo gros la sogs pa thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la 4yang dag par zhugs pa nyi khri dang yang thabs cig rigo/ /de nas bcom ldan sgyu 'das 'khor brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te chos ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo 7g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 8te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod la de bzhin gshegs pas dris pa lung bstan pa'i phyir/ rtag tu skabs phyes 9pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang ngas dris pa de dang de'i lung bstan pas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom 55—553

ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa dang mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin kyang 'thob cing / ting nge 'dzin de thob ma thag tu ji lta ji ltar sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar lus mngon par sprul nas sems can rnams kyi mos pa ji lta ba de bzhin du chos ston pa dang / ci nas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba lags/ de skad ces gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po la 1'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po legs so legs so/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod ni 'di ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba la lhag par bya ba byas pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po la bsnyen 2bkur byas pa ste/ khyod 'di ltar sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba dang / snying rje bar zhugs pas pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la don 'di 'dri bar sems pa ni legs so/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang / ngas khyod la bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po chos gcig dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na med pa yang dag 55—554

par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa dang / mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin kyang 'thob cing ting nge 'dzin de thob ma thag tu ji lta ji ltar sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar lus mngon par sprul nas/ sems can rnams kyi mos pa ji lta ba de bzhin du chos ston pa dang / ci nas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /chos gcig po gang zhe na/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po 'di la byang chub sems dpa' khams gsum pa thams cad la mi gnas pa yin te/ nang ngam phyi rol la gnas par mi byed do/ /de gnas pa med pas yang dag pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa mthong bas yang dag pa la sbyor bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa la sbyor bas ci la yang blo thogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /de blo thogs pa med pas yang dag pa'i bya ba la spyod do/ /yang dag pa'i bya ba la spyod pa de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/chos thams cad ni rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste/ chos gang yang ther zug tu gnas pa ma yin no/ /chos thams cad ni rkyen las 'byung ba ste/ rkyen med par 'byung ba'i chos ni gang yang med do/ /chos gang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba de ni ma skyes pa'o/ /de ltar na chos thams cad ni skye ba med pa ste/chos thams cad ma skyes par rtogs par gyur pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i lam la 'jug pa rtogs pa 'thob bo/ /'di ltar sems can thams cad la phan pa'i dngos po dang / snying rje'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /de de ltar mos pas chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rab tu shes so/ /chos thams cad ni yongs su brtags pas sprul pa ste/ yongs su brtags pa de yang 1shin tu stong 55wa 555

pa'o / /chos thams cad stong par rtogs pa de ni sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob ste/ ting nge 'dzin de thob ma thag tu ji lta ji ltar sems can rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar lus mngon par sprul nas sems can rnams kyi mos pa ji lta ba de bzhin du chos ston pa dang / ci nas myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di thob pa gang la la dag 'khor 'dir 'dus pa lta mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po 'khor 'di na bsams bzhin du go cha bgos pa gang dag sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di thob pa skyes bu dam pa drug cu 1yod den/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa drug cu 3po dag sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di thob pa yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das skyes bu dam pa 'di dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid du sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di thob pa lags sam/ 'on te la'ajig rten gyi khams gzhan dag na yang gang dag 5sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di thob pa'i skyes bu dam pa dag kyang mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas nub kyi phyogs cha logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya stong 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can zhes bya ba yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs 55—556

pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med ces bya ba da ltar bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes la chos kyang ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob ces bya ba dang gnyis ting nge 'dzin 'di thob pa yin te/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po skyes bu dam pa de gnyis las byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang gzhan dag nub bdun du 'dri ba'i lan nyan pa de dag sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob bo/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni mang du mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni sgrim 1mi 'tshal bar skyes bu dam pa de gnyis las chos 'dri ba'i lan nyan pa'i slad du'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po ji skad zer ba de de bzhin te/ de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang dag sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa dag ni tshad med grangs med do/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ji lta bu'i sems kyi mtshan ma bstan pas/ skyes bu dam pa de gnyis 'jig 55—557

rten gyi khams mi mjed 1'dir mchi 2bar 'gyur ba dang / bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams de 3dang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na gda' 4bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa legs par mdzad du gsol/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das skyes bu dam pa de gnyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir mchis na/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo rnams kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ skyes bu dam pa de gnyis las chos 'dri ba'i lan thos pas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin kyang thob par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de dang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de yang mthong ste/ mthong nas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing der skye bar smon lam 'debs pa dang / der skyes ma thag tu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba'i slad du'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos gsol ba btab par mkhyen nas/ mdzod spu nas 'od rab tu bkye ste/'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di gser gyi kha dog gi snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ ri'i tshogs dang shing ljon pa dang ri'i rgyal po ri ci rab dang /ri btang bzung tshodang btang bzung chen po dang khor /yug dang khor yug chen 55—558

po gang dag yod pa dang / gang dag 'jig rten gyi bar gyi mun pa mun nag de dag thams cad kyang gser gyi kha dog gi snang ba des khyab par gyur to/ /nyi ma dang zla ba 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba/ 'di ltar mthu che ba/ 'di ltar dbang che bar grags pa 'di dag kyang mig gi dbang po la snang bar ma gyur to/ /nub phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya stong las thal nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de thams cad gser gyi kha dog gi snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /de nas 'od de bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal 1te/ lan bdun bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i spyan sngar mi snang bar gyur ton/ /de nas gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can der skyes pa'i sems can rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang nyan thos chen po de dag gis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir rimathong zhing de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyis bltas pa de yang mthong ste/ dper na skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar mthong nas/ de dag dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba rgya cher skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes tshig de skad kyang brjod cado/ /'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du gang dag 'dus pa dge slong dang dge slong ma dang dge bsnyen dang dge 55wa 559

bsnyen ma dang / lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang / mi ma yin pa dang ske/ brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'dus pa de dag gis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de dang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor cing nyan thos kyi dge 'dun gyis mdun 1gyis bltas te/ ri'i rgyal po bzhin du 'bar ba de dang thams cad dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de yang sa ler mthong ste/ 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu mig dang ldan pas/ 'dom nagang tsam gyi phyogs na skyes bu cig shos kyi bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor sgrim lami dgos par mthong ba de bzhin dul/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dang sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu 5med pa tshomathong ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can yon tan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas gang ba yon tan gyi bkod 7pa chen po dang ldan pa de yang snang ngo ske/ /mthong nas kyang dga' ba dang mchog tu dga' ba rgya chen po skyes te/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo zhes tshig de skad kyang brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang dag par bstan par namadzad pa na sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na sngon sems ma bskyed pa'i srog chags brgyad khri bzhi stong bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 55wa 560

tu yang dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang nyan thos chen po gang dag 'khod pa de dag gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di mthong nas/ ngo mtshar du gyur te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal zhing tshig 'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes kyang brjod 1do / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang nyan thos chen po de dag gis tshig de brjod ma thag tu de'i tshe/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de rnam pa drug tu 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul/g.yos rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg / 'ur 'ur/na rab tu 'ur 'ur/da kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur/la'akhrugs rab tu 'khrugs/ kun tu rab tu 'khrugs/ chem chem/ rab tu chem chem / kun tu rab tu chem chem mo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 5te/zhe sa dang bcas par phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /skyes bu dam pa de gnyis phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 6dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 55—561

sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de mthu brtan 1pa brnyes pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de'i mtshan brjod pa tsam gyis sems pa rnam mchis pa'i dog sa 'di yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa'i snyad 3du'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyis skyes bu dam pa de gnyis la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i mtshan brjod par ma zad kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan du ma cadag na yang bcom ldan 'das de'i mtshan yongs su brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad kyang 'od des reg pas rnam pa drug tu rab tu tshogayos so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag 7de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i mtshan thos nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de las byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag bzhi bcu 8bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i mtshan thos so/ /thos nas kyang de dag thams cad 'dus nas mgrin gcig tu dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par lung bstan to/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang 55— 562

dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des sngon ma mthong ma thos pa'i 'od 'di btang ba rgyu ma mchis rkyen ma mchis par ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas 'di ltar yid du mchi ba dang / 'di ltar blta na sdug pa'i 'od mi gtong na gang gi slad du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa des 'di ltar yid du mchi ba dang / 'di ltar blta na sdug pa'i 'od bkye ba 'di'i rgyu ni gang lags rkyen ni ci lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyis skyes bu dam pa de gnyis la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag ji skad smras pa de de bzhin te/ rgyu med rkyen med par bcom ldan 'das des 'di ltar yid du 'ong ba dang / 'di ltar blta na sdug pa'i 'od mi bkye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa 1de deng byang chub sems dpa' 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rin po che bsgrub pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs ston par 'gyur te/ de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa des chos bstan pa de'i snga ltas su 'di ltar yid /du 'ong ba dang / 'di ltar blta na sdug pa'i 'od 'di bkye'o/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems 55—563

dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la blta ba dang / phyag bgyi ba dang mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang chos bstan pa de yang mnyan pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der mchi'o/ /bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu dag 1bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de khyod nyid las brtsams te/ chos ston par 'gyur gyis /de'i dus la dbab par shes pa/ khyed deng 4shig ces skabs phye bas de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob kyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med de'i nyen 5'khor na 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag bzhi bcu po rnams la smras pa/ rigs kyi bu dag tshur shog /khyed kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / chos bstan pa de yang mnyan pa'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der 'dong ngo tsho/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa gzhan dang gzhan dag na yod pa spangs nas/ smon lam dang thugs rje chen pos sangs rgyas kyi zhing nyon mongs pa can der byung ste/ sems can dman pa la mos pa 'dod chags kyi shas che ba/zhe sdang gi shas che ba/ gti mug gi shas che ba rnams kyi nang du/ bla na med 55wa 564

pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ni dka' ba mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /skyes bu dam pa de 1gnyis kyis/ tshig 'di smras ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad lhan cig 'dus nas/ mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gang dag gis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa de'i mtshan thos pa de dag kyang rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa lags na/ gang dag gis sha'i mig gis nade mngon sum du mthong la mthong nas kyang dad pa rnyed pa dag lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de la blta ba dang / phyag bgyi ba dang bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang / chos bstan pa de yang mnyan pa'i slad du 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed der mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi 4bu dag khyed de'i dus la dbab 5par shes na deng 6shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis yongs su bskor te/ mdun du bdar nas/'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de nas dong ngo / /de nas de'i tshe ji lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du byas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag brgyad cu 7rtsa bzhi po de dag thams cad re re la yang khang pa brtsegs pa bye ba phrag brgyad cu nartsa bzhi sprul pa de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du byas so/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag kyang gru bzhi lham pa ka ba 55wa 565

bzhi zug pa/ cha mnyam par legs par rnam par phye 1ba legs par zin pa sha stag go/ /khang pa brtsegs /pa re re yang 'phang du ni dpag tshad bcu gnyis/rgyar ni dpag tshad 3brgyad do/ /khang pa brtsegs pa dag gser las byas pa dag kyang yod/ dngul las byas pa dag kyang yod/ bai drur+ya calas byas pa dag kyang yod/ shel las byas pa dag kyang yod/ mu tig dmar po dang rdo'i snying po dang / spug las byas pa dag kyang yod do/ /rin po che gser dang dngul dang sna gnyis pa dag kyang yod/ rin po che gser dang dngul dang be+e drur+ya ci dang sna gsum pa dag kyang yod/ rin po che gser dang dngul dang bai drur+ya 6dang shel dang sna bzhi pa dag kyang yod/ rin po che gser dang dngul dang be+e drur+ya dang shel dang mu tig 8dmar po dang sna lnga pa'i 9khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ rin po che gser dang dngul dang bai drur+ya 1 dang shel dang mu tig 1 dmar po dang spug dang sna drug pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ rin po che gser dang dngul dang bai drur+ya dang shel dang mu tig rka dmar po dang spug 1 dang rdo'i snying po dang sna bdun pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ tsan dan dmar po las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po las byas pa dag kyang yod/ a ka 15ru dang tsan dan las byas pa dag kyang yod/ a ga ru nag po dang tsan dan las byas pa dag kyang yod/ tsan dan thams cad las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ me tog ud pa la dang pad ma dang ku mu da dang pad ma dkar po las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ sna ma'i me tog dang bar sha ka dang tsam pa ka dang /skya snar dang a ti mug ta ka dang ta ra ni dang go ta ra ni las byas pa'i khang pa 55wa 566

brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ me tog da nu ska ri las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ me tog man dā 1ra dang man dā 2ra chen po las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ me tog pa ru ṣa dka dang pa ru ṣa 4ka chen po dang mdzi ṣa 5ka dang mañdzu ṣa ( ka chen po dang / mdog mdzes dang mdog chamadzes chen po dang / me tog 'khor lo dang 'khor lo chen po dang kun tu 'khor lo dang ske/ shin tu mdzes pa'i 'khor lo dang me tog zla ba dang zla ba chen po dang /shin tu mdzes pa'i zla ba dang zla ba mchog dang / sba la dang sbya la chen napo dang /shin tu mdzes pa'i s+tha la las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ me tog thams cad las byas pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag kyang yod/ kha dog du ma pa kha dog sna tshogs kha dog brgya stong du ma pa bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa yongs su dag pa/ 'od gsal ba dag kyang yod do/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang lha'i bu mo brgyad khri bzhi stong mngon par sprul te/ de na lha'i bu mo kha cig gi lag na dung dang rnga bo che dang rdza rnga dang khar rnga dang pi bang rgyud gcig pa dang glu/ glu dbyangs sgra snyan pa dang gling bu dang rgyud can pi bang dang pi bang rgyud nagasum pa rnams thogs te/ sil snyan dang glu dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra skad rnam 1 pa mang po de lta bu len cing 'khod do/ /lha'i bu mo kha cig ni tsan dan dmar po'i phye ma'i phur ma thogs shing 'khod do/ /lha'i bu mo kha cig ni tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma'i phur ma thogs shing 'khod do/ /lha'i bu mo kha cig ni a ga ru dang tsan dan gyi phye ma'i phur ma thogs shing 'khod do/ /lha'i bu mo kha cig ni a ga ru nag po dang tsan dan gyi phye ma'i phur ma thogs shing 'khod do/ /lha'i bu mo kha cig ni tsan dan thams cad kyi phye ma'i phur ma thogs shing 'khod do/ /55wa 567

lha'i bu mo kha cig ni ud pa la dang pad 1ma dang ku mu da dang pad ma dkar po'i me tog gi phye ma'i phur ma thogs shing 'khod do/ /lha'i bu mo kha cig ni me tog man dā 2ra dang man dā rir chen po dang pa ru ṣa 4ka dang pa ru ṣa 5ka chen po dang mañdzu ṣa 6ka dang mañdzu ṣa 7ka chen po dang / me tog namadog mdzes dang mdog mdzes chen po dang / me tog 'khor lo dang 'khor lo chen po dang /kun tu 'khor lo dang shin tu mdzes pa'i 'khor lo dang / me tog zla ba dang zla ba chen po dang / shin tu mdzes pa'i zla ba dang zla ba mchog dang / s+tha la dang sba la chen po dang shin tu mdzes pa'i s+tha la'i me tog gi phye ma'i phur ma thogs shing 'khod do/ /lha'i bu mo kha cig ni me tog thams cad dang bdug pa dang spos dang me tog phreng dang byug pa dang phye ma'i phur ma thogs shing 'khod do/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang bkod pa chen po'i seng ge'i khri la skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 9rtsa gnyis kyis sku legs par brgyan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i 1 sku mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang mu tig dkar po dang mu tig 11dmar po dang mu tig mthon ku'i mu tig gi phreng ba brgyad khri bzhi stong mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang lha'i ras bcos bu'i rgyal mtshan gser gyi dril bu g.yer ma'i dra bas g.yogs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang spos kyi phur ma brgyad khri bzhi stong mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang gdugs kha dog du ma pa kha dog 〈sna tshogs pa/ kha dog brgya stong du ma bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/legs par las su byas pa/ dbyibs shin tu legs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang shing ta la'i phreng ba brgyad khri bzhi 55wa 568

stong mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang rin po che'i shing ljon pa brgyad khri bzhi stong mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba gang dag rlung gis bskyod pa na 'di lta bu'i sgra dag 'byung ba 'di lta ste dper na/ lha'i sil snyan yan lag bye ba brgya stong dang ldan pa mkhas pa dag gis legs par blangs nas sgra 'byung ba de bzhin du dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba de dag kyang rlung gis bskyod na sgra snyan pa yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung ba brgyad khri bzhi stong mngon par sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang rdzing bu gzhi gser gyi bye ma bdal ba/ bai drur+ya 1dang shel gyis spras pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyi kha khyer gyis bskor ba/ me tog ud pa la dang pad ma dang ku mu da dang pad ma dkar pos gang ba/ ngur pa sgra 'byin pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ bya rog gis btung du rung bar mu dang kha da chad du gang ba dag sprul to/ /khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang rin po che'i shing ljon pa'i phreng ba rim pa bdun gyis bskor to/ /rin po che'i skud pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gis kun nas dkris so/ /rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa re re'i na'od kyis kyang dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong du snang bar gyur to/ /de bzhin du khang pa brtsegs pa thams cad kyi bkod pa dag so sor byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag gi khang pa brtsegs pa bkod pa ji snyed yod pa/khang pa brtsegs pa de dag thams cad kyi nang na bkod pa chen po gang dag yod pa de dag thams cad khang pa brtsegs pa re rer mngon par sprul to/ /snga ma 55—569

bzhin du sbyar te/ khang pa brtsegs pa re rer yang de ltar bkod pa rnams mngon par sprul nas/ bkod pa de lta bu des byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag brgyad khri bzhi stong dang lhan cig tu 'di lta ste dper tshan/ skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa'i lag pa bskum pa las rkyong 1ba dang / brkyang nab las skum 3pa tsam gyis de dag skad cig thang cig yud tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de nas mi snang bar gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir phyin to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de gnyis kyis de'i tshe ji lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par byas pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di lag mthil bzhin du mnyam par gyur pa/ de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par byas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang khang pa brtsegs pa bye ba phrag brgyad cu 4rtsa ru bzhis yongs su bskor te mdun du bdar nas/ yon tan gyi bkod pa chen po dang ldan pas shin tu lhag ge'o/ /khang pa brtsegs pa de dag gi 'od kyis kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di snang bas khyab par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i tshosangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ skyes bu dam pa de gnyis kyis tshig 'thun 8par sgra dbyangs gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /gzi brjid mtshungs ‘ med yon tan 55—570

phung po gcig la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong chen po kun mkhyen yon tan kun gyi pha rol gshegs/ /thams cad zil gnon srid pa gsum gyi chags pa'i lam las 'das / /shākya khyu mchog dri bral zla ba'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma dri med lta bu'i sku dang ldan pa rnam par mdzes/ /mtshan mchog sum cu 1rtsa gnyis dag gi go cha mnabs 2gyur cing / /dpe byad bzang po rnams kyis spras pa 'jig rten kun 3tu gsal/ /mi mchog khyod mtshungs 'jig rten gsum na gang yang yod lam mchis/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i sku yi 'od kyis gang tshe reg gyur pa/ /de tshe 'jig rten nyi ma zla ba nor bu zhugs rnams dang / /brgya byin tshangs pa lha dang de bzhin mi ci rnams kyi 'od/ /snag tsha'i phung po bzhin du mog mog mi snang gsal ma mchis/ /rgyal ba zhing gcig na ni yang dag bzhugs par gda' bzhin du/ /'gro ba'i don du skad cig gcig gis mtha' yas zhing du gshegs/ /ston pa'i bzhud dang byon pa 'tshal ba su yang yod ma mchis/ /mdzad pa dag dang 'dul ba sna tshogs dag gis sems can 'dul/ /spu yi khung gcig nang du mtha' yas zhing rnams ston mdzad kyang / /'phel ba dang ni bri bar gyur pa gang yang yod ma mchis/ /'di ni ji bzhin las dang byed pa rgyu dang 'bras gda' la / /sems can rnams la gnod pa ma mchis 'dres par gyur ma mchis/ /gang na sems can dmyal ba dud 'gro yi dgas 8ma mchis shing / /rgyal ba'i sras po grags pa chen po dag gis yongs gang la/ /mi khom brgyad po dag dang bral te mchog tu nyams dga' ba'i/ /yongs dag zhing de dag kyang mi mchog la lar ‘ ston pa mdzad/ /lha mi gang dag mi 'jigs bag ma mchis pa bkang 0slad du / /sems dmyal dud 'gro yi dgas rka'agro ba shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /kun 55—571

nas nyon mongs zhing rnams la la dag kyang bstan mdzad nas/ /de dag thams cad bde bar gshegs la skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /zhing gzhan la la dag kyang nam mkha' lta bur ston par mdzad/ /de bzhin gzhan yang zhugs kyis gtam zhing 1me lce 'khrugs pa dang / /zhing gzhan dag kyang chab dkyis yongs su gtams par ston pa jimadzad/ /rnam 'phrul 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yul lags so/ /'dul ba'i don du gzugs kyi rnam pa mtha' yas ston mdzad pa/ /la lar 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'od chags gzugs dang ldan par 'gyur5te/ /tshangs pa'i bdag po mchog tu zhi ba'i ting 'dzin rnyed pa dang / /sum cu tshom gsum dbang phyug mig stong rdo rje 'bar ba dang / /srog chags brgya phrag mang po rab tu dga' bas mchod bgyid cing / /dge ba bcu po dag gis sems can mtha' yas 'dul bgyid pa/ /blon po tshong dpon dag dang bka' la gtogs pa'i gtsor gyur cing / /shin tu 'jigs med dgra tshogs phab nas chad pas mi gcod la/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi 7pos sems can rnams ni sdud bgyid cing / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam la sems can rab tu 'jog bgyid pa//bsod nams las kyis rin chen bdun dang ldan par gyur pa yi/ /gling bzhi dag gi dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur 8ba dag tu gyur/ /'jig rten 'di na la lar bltam pa lta bur ston mdzad de/ /dog sa la ni gom pa bdun dag bor zhing gshegs sanas kyang / /nga ni skyes nas skye dang 'chi ba'i tha mar dbyung ngo zhes / /yid 'ong yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gsung mchog brjod pa mdzad/ /mar me mdzad pa tshun chad dri ma thams cad spang 1lags kyang / /'gro rnams sangs rgyas ye shes mchog la yongs smin mdzad slad du/ /la lar sems can 55—572

dag pa btsun mo'i 'khor na bzhugs par gda'/ /mi yi dbang po btsun mo dag dang sras kyang ston pa 1mdzad/ /yab yum dag dang gnyen gyi rtsa lag sdug pa'i 'khor rnams dang / /yul 'khor 'byor dang rin chen gter mdzod mang po btang mdzad nas/ /brgya byin tshangs pa dag dang lha min 2rnams kyis phyag bgyis shing / /drang srong chen po mngon par byung ste nags na bzhugs par gda' / /'gro la sman slad dgung 3lo drug tu dka' ba spyad nas ni/ /bsam gtan mkha' khyab rin chen mchog la bsam gtan mdzad par gda'/ /mu stegs can gyi tshogs rnams thams cad tshar gcad mdzad slad du/ /sems can dag pa byang chub shing drung du yang gshegs par gda'/ /'gro rnams sangs rgyas ye shes mchog tu yongs smin mdzad slad du/ /mi dbang sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin mchog la bzhugs mdzad nas/ /sku yi tshul ni gang gis 'jig rten rnam par 'dul 'gyur ba/ /rgyal ba de 'dra nyid kyi sku yi cha lugs 'dzin par mdzad/ /ji ltar sgyu ma mkhan gyis 'gro 4ba rmongs par bgyi slad du/ /sgyu ma mang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu ston bgyid pa/ /de bzhin 'gro ba ru sgron mas sems can 'dul bar mdzad slad du/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mang po rnams kyang ston/ /thub pa dpa' bo la lar dpung dang bcas pa'i bdud 'dul ston / /gang la pha rol mu stegs tshogs kyi 'gro ba ma mchis shing / /rdul bral mya ngan ma mchis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob pa/ /bla na med pa 'gyur ba ma mchis 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /khyod kyis bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang nas byang chub brnyes/ /phyogs kyi lam rnams thams cad du yang 'khor lo bskor ba mdzad / /mi yi dbang po kun nas zhal ldan chu zla bzhin du bzhugs/ /bde 55—573

gshegs rang byung mtha' yas yul la bdag cag phyag 'tshal lo/ /la la dag la sangs rgyas chos kyi sku ni ston mdzad pa/ /rtag pa brtan pa ther zug 'gyur ba ma mchis gyur pa /dang / /ma bgyis ma skyes dri ma ma mchis 'gog pa ma mchis chos / /mig yor 'dra bas phyogs bcu dag ni shin tu rgyas par 'gengs/ /ring por mi thogs par ni sdug pa dag dang 'bral 2'gyur gyis / /'dus byas 'di la khyed cag yid brtan bya ba'i mi rigs zhes / /'gro ba thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma smig ci rgyu 'dra ba dang / /mi rtag mi brtan skad cig par yang la la dag la ston/ /bde gshegs sku yi phrin tsholas mtha' dang pha rol yod 7ma mchis / /gsung dang thugs kyi 'jug pa'i spyod yul dag kyang dpag mi lang / /nam mkha' lta bur rgya che tshad ma mchis pa ston mdzad de/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul sems can rnams kyis 'tshal bar nus ma lags/ /phyogs bcu dag na mchis pa'i sems can ma lus ji snyed pa/ /de dag shā ri'i bu dang 'dra bar shes rab ldan gyur kyang / /rgyal ba chos kyi rgyal po'i dngos po'i yul tshad ma mchis pa/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul thams cad de dag rnams kyis rig mi nus/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mkha' 'dra pha rol mtha' ma mchis/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i yul ni bsam gyis mi khyab ma lus pa/ /'di na 8rgyal ba'i sras rnams kun dang nyan thos rnams dang ni/ /rkyen gyi rgyal ba 'dus pa rnams kyis 'tshal bar nus ma lags / /de ltar 'di dag la 0sogs mtha' yas thabs dang ldan pa yi / /'dul ba'i don du sku yi mdzad pa mtha' yas ston par mdzad/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs par mtha' yas sku dang ldan gyur pa/ /mgon po rtog dang rnam par rtog dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho rgya chen pha rol 55—574

rab tu rgal 1gyur pa/ /nyon mongs thul ba rgyal ba 'gro ba'i gtso la bstod pa yi / /bsod nams ci mchis des 2ni 'di na 3'gro ba ma lus pa/ /byang chub rin chen rab mchog zhi zhing bde la reg par shog /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang paphyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob kyis tshul dang 'thun ci pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par bstod nas/bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bcom ldan 'das la gnod pa chung ngam zhes snyun tshogasol lo/ /nyam nga ba nyung ngam / bskyod pa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde bar reg pa la gnas sam zhes kyang snyun kyigasol lo/ /'di skad ces bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dag 'jig rten gyi khams nyams dga' ba la bltar 8stsol cig ces kyang gsung ngo / /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ‘ 'di'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos chen po de dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di khang pa brtsegs pa'i bkod pa chen po des yongs su khyab pa dang / rin po che sna tshogs dag kyang mthong nas ngo mtshar du 'dzin cing de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can nas 'dir lhags pa 'di dag ci de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu'am / 'on te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di dag gi mthu yin snyam mo/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di khang pa 55—575

brtsegs pa sna tshogs du mas brgyan cing yongs su khyab par gda' ba ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa mchog tu ngo mtshar to/ /gang dag 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can nas 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir lhags pa dag ci de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu lags sam/ 'on te byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag gi mthu lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang pa brtsegs pa du mas brgyan cing yongs su khyab par snang ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu ma yin gyi/'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 1mthu chen thob kyi mthu yin no / /gsol pa 'di ltar 'di dag gis 2mthus 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'di rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang pa brtsegs pa du mas brgyan cing yongs su khyab par gda' ba ni skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis kyi smon lam dag dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba dag yongs su sbyangs pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar snyeto / /bde bar gshegs pa mchog tu ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po ji skad smras pa de de bzhin te/skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa nas dge ba'i rtsa ba dag yongs su sbyangs pa yin no/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis ni sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa yin te/ 'di gnyis sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par sprul pa 55—576

'di lta bu 'di dag ston to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod shar gyi phyogs cha logs su de na ci snang ltos shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos byang chub sems dpa'i lha'i mig sgrib pa med pas bltas na shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed mthong ngo sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyi zhabs la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 1mthu chen thob gnyis phyag 'tshal 2nas tshig 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med/ bcom ldan 'das la gnod pa chung ngam zhes snyan gsol lo/ /nyam nga ba nyung ngam/ bskyod pa yang ngam/ stobs dang bde bar reg pa la gnas sam zhes kyang snyun gsol lo zhes smra'o/ /de bzhin du lho'i phyogs cha dang / de bzhin du nub dang / de bzhin du byang dang /de bzhin du 'og dang / de bzhin du steng dang / de bzhin du phyogs bcu kun tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i bkod pa chen po du mas brgyan cing yongs su khyab par mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag thams cad na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag kyang mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad kyi spyan snga na skyes bu dam pa de gnyis zhabs la phyag 'tshal bar yang mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de 3shin tu ngo mtshar cher 'dzin par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ bcom 55—577

ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'di ltar skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis kyis sgyu ma lta bu'i 1ting nge 'dzin mngon par bsgrubs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa mchog tu ngo mtshar to/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad na gda' ba'i slad du'o/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis ji lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par mdzad pas/ byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos phyogs bcu kun gyi nasangs rgyas kyi zhing dag mthong ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag dang skyes bu dam pa de gnyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba mthong ba dang / de bzhin du thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor des kyang phyogs bcu kun gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag mthong ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag dang / skyes bu dam pa de gnyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gi zhabs la phyag 'tshal ba mthong ba dang / mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor srog chags sum khri nyis stong bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par mdzad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa gang las bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas ji srid cig rilags/ de'i mtshan ni ci zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 55—578

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis legs par bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag kyang de'i bya ba dang / de'i spyod pa dang / de'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur te/ de lta bas na pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod shin tu legs par nyon la yid la zung shig 1dang bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te / bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa grangs med pa'i yang ches grangs med pa yangs pa tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong gi rdul phra rab ji snyed yod pa de snyed du tshad med pa/ de snyed du bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ rdul phra rab kyi rdul ji catsam yod pa de bas kyang ches mang ba'i bskal pa byung ba de'i tshe de'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan rin chen bsags pa dpag tu med pa bde ba kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ci ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gser 'od seng ge'i tshornam par rol pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba byung ste/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing na 8yon tan bkod pa gang dag yod pa de ‘ dag dpe 55—579

cung zad tsam gyis cung zad cig brjod par bya yis 1nyon cig /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po 'di ji snyam du sems/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa mang ngam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang lags so/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ tshad ma mchis te/ ngag gi las kyis lan 2gdab par sla ba ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying tre 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig gis skra'i rtse mo brgyar gshags pa'i rtse 4mos rgya mtsho chen po las chu thigs pa gcig blangs na pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po 'di ji snyam du sems/ chu blangs pa dang ske/ lhag ma lus pa de gang mang / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das blangs pa ni nyung / lhag ma lus pa ni tshad ma mchis so/ /bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod mos 5par bya'o/ /khyod kyi khong du chud par bya'o/ /mi des skra'i rtse mo brgyar gshags 6pa'i rtse mo des rgya mtsho chen po las chu'i thigs pa gcig blangs pa ji snyed pa de tsam du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod par blta'o/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu'i phung po ji snyed pa de tsam du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 7yon tan rin chen bsags pa dpag tu med pa bde ba kun tu ston pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi yon tan bkod par blta'o/ /de'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun yang dpag tu med de / ji ltar da 9ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag 55—580

med kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dpag tu med do zhes bya na/ de las brgya stong du bsgres 1pa bas kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po de'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ches mang ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i 2dge 'dun yang de snyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa de ni theg pa gsum kho na las brtsams te chos ston to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po ngas bskal pa gang cigā'i klung gi 5bye ma snyed du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa dang / nyan thos kyi yon tan bkod pa dang / bde ba'i rgyu las brtsams te chos bstan par 'dod kyang / nga'i spobs pa yang zad par mi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa de'i mthar phyin par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po de'i gsung rab la 'jig rten gyi khams stong gi dbang phyug chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid ces bya ba'i rgyal po zhig byung ste/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid de la bu bye ba phrag brgya yod de/ rgyal bu gzhon nu de dag thams cad kyang skyes bu chen po'i mtshan nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang ldan par gyur to/ /de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs par gyur to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid kyi yongs su longs spyod pa'i skyed 7mos tshal ni bdun khri drug stong yod do/ /rgyal bu re re la yang longs 55—581

spyod kyi skyed 1mos tshal khri khri yod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na bud med mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de ni med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na bud med ming yang mi grag ste/ rgyal bu gzhon nu de dag thams cad kyang tshangs par spyod pa las gyur pa/ brdzus te byung ba sha stag go/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyang bsam gtan gyi dga' ba dang / chos kyi dga' ba'i zas 2can yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na kha zas rags 3pa med par gyur to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid de ni las gzhan med de bu de rnams dang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das de la lo bye ba stong phrag brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bar du bsnyen bkur byas so/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa des de'i lhag pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas tshad med pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i chos kyi tshul la mkhas pa yang dag par rab tu bstan to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po tshad med pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i chos kyi tshul la mkhas pa gang zhe na/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos spyod pa tshad med pa dag don tu gnyer bar mi bya ba de gang yang med do/ /rtul ci ba tshad med pa gang dag brtsam par mi bya ba de gang yang med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sbyin pa ni tshad med do/ /tshul khrims ni tshad med/ bzod pa ni tshad med/ brtson 'grus ni tshad med/ bsam gtan ni tshad med/ shes rab ni tshad med/ 'khor ba yongs tshosu 'dzin pa ni tshad med / sems can dag la byams pa ni tshad med/ zhing gi bkod pa dag ni 55—582

tshad med/ nyan thos dag ni tshad med/ gzugs yongs su grub pa dag ni tshad medam/ dbyangs ni tshad med/ spobs pa ni tshad med pa'i phyir ro/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po byang chub sems dpa' ni tha na sems bskyed pa gcig gis dge ba'i rtsa ba gang ci mngon par 'du byed pa de dag thams cad tshad med pa nyid du yongs su bsngo'o/ /ji ltar yongs su bsngos pas tshad med par 'gyur zhe na/gang gi tshe sems can thams cad la yongs su sngo 1bar byed pa de'i tshe sems can 'di dag thams cad skye ba med par mngon sum du byed/ sangs rgyas kyi yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 2'gyur ba 'di ni rigs kyi bu yongs su bsngo ba tshad med pa zhes bya'o/ /stong pa nyid tshad med pa'o / /mtshan ma med pa tshad med pa'o/ /smon pa med pa tshad med pa'o/ /mngon par 'du bya ba med pa tshad med pa'o/ /de ltar na 'dod chags dang bral ba yang dag pa'i mtha' chos kyi dbyings rnam par grol ba/ ma skyes pa/ dben pa / bral ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa/ tshad med pa 4ste/ rigs kyi bu mdor na chos thams cad ni tshad med pa'o/ /de'i phyir chos thams cad ni ma skyes pa/ma 'gags pa zhes bya'o/ /gang mi skye mi 'gag pa de ni tshad med pa'o/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal pos de ltar rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid de la tshad med pa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i chos kyi tshul la mkhas pa 'di yang dag par rab tu bstan to/ /des kyang chos tshad med pa dag la nges par sems par byas par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid kyis bcom ldan 'das de las chos dpag tu med pa bstan pa 'di thos nas tshim 55—583

zhing mgu ste/ yi rangs nas rab tu dga' ste dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bu de dag dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das de la tshigs su bcad pa dag gis mngon par bstod pa/ 'dren pa chos rnams kun la dbang sgyur ba/ /smra ba'i tshogs rnams yang dag rab tu 'joms/ /bdud kyi rtsod dang nyon mongs kun sel ba/ /mtshungs med ye shes mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi zla dag dang me yi 'od rnams dang / /brgya byin tshangs pa nor bu glog 'od rnams/ /bde gshegs gzi brjid kyis ni mog mog gyur/ /mi mchog 'od mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa bskal pa rgya mtsho 'das par 1yang / /dka' nab rnam pa du ma spyod par mdzad/ /phrin salas de yi 'bras bu yid 'ong caste/ /des na 'gro bas bltas na ngoms mi 'gyur/ /skye dang rga dang na dang 5'chis gtses shing ske/ /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir gzigs nas/ /de dag rnams la thub chen thugs rje ste/ /rtag tu mi 'pho zhi ba'i chos kyang ston/ /srid gsum srog chags kun gyi sman pa 'dra/ /'dod chags zhe snang mun pa thams cad sbyong tsho/ /thugs 7rje bskyed pa mdzad nas chos kyi sman/ /zhi ba bla na med par rab tu ston/ /sems can kun 8gyi spyod pa rab tu mkhyen/ /rab 'byam 9zhing rnams kun na srog chags kyi/ /mkhyen nas gang gis mya ngan 'das mchog la/ /reg par 'gyur ba de 'dra'i chos kyang ston/ /mi mchog khyod kyi thugs rje ci 'dra ba / /ji snyed rab 'byam zhing gi nyan thos dang / /rkyen byung thub pa ma 11lus de dag la/ /de 'dra ba yi snying rje yong 1 ma mchis/ /bsod nams phung po mtshan mchog rnams dang ldan/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /bye ba'i nyi las lhag pa'i gzi mnga' ba/ /mi mchog mtshungs ma mchis la phyag 'tshal lo//55—584

chos sprin rgya 1las chos char 'bebs pa na/ /gang dag rgya chen mos pa spyod yul ba / /sngon gyi sangs rgyas spyod la 'jigs ma mchis/ /de dag rtag tu bde gshegs mdun na mchis/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig bsam yas su/ /mi mchog mthong ba rnyed par shin tu dka'/ /bsod nams las kyis bsam pa yongs sbyangs pa/ /de dag mig lam rnam par 'dren rnams gda'/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni chos dbyings rgyas par 'gengs/ /zhing rnams rab 'byam 2thams cad na yang gda'/ /bzhud dang byon par mngon pa yod ma mchis/ /'on kyang 'jig rten dag na snod bzhin gda'/ /bden pa gzigs shing don dam ston pa por/ /chos kyi sbyin bdag zhi ba'i thugs ldan pa/ /rgal sgyu nas srog chags bcings gyur gzhan sgrol ba/ /bde bar gshegs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyis skye ba'i shing ljon rtsa nas bton/ /nga rgyal ri bo sra ba rdul du brlags/ /rgod 7pa mi mnga' g.yo dang sgyu dang bral/ /rab zhi thugs dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi mchog chags pa thams cad yong 8mi mnga'/ /dgongs pa sa dang chu dang me dang 'dra/ /rgyal ba sems can kun la snyoms thugs ldan/ /rlung dang nam mkha' 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thub pa chen po yon tan 'di 'dra'i gter/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho las byung sku dang ldan/ /bskal pa khrag khrig dag tu de brjod kyang / /yon tan rgya mtsho zad par nus ma lags/ /yon tan rgya mtsho lha mis mchod pa la/ /bdag ni bu dang bcas te mchod pa bgyid/ /rgyal ba mchod pa'i bsod nams ci mchis pa/ /des ni 9thub pa chen po khyod 'drar shog /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de nas rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid de dus gzhan zhig na/ skyed mos tshal na bsam gtan gyi gnas pas gnas shing 55—585

'dug pa'i blo 1g.yas g.yon nas/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i pad ma bkra ba blta na sdug pa dag pa gnyis byung ngo / /pad ma de gnyis las khye'u ming rin chen sems dang / rin chen mchog ces bya ba gnyis rdzus te byung nas/ skyil mo krung ri bcas te 'dug go/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de ltar rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid de ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas khye'u gnyis skyil mo krung 3bcas te 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshigs su bcad pa 'di smras so//khyed caganyis lha 'am klu yin nam/ /gnod sbyin dri za mi ci 'am5 mi 'am mi ma yin nam ci/ /dris pa smros shig grogs po dag /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de ltar rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid kyi g.yas phyogs su byung ba'i khye'u gang yin pa des rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid de la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ grogs po chos kun stong pa yi/ /ming ni 'dri bar byed dam ci/ /chos rnams 7thams cad ming med na/ /gang gi ming ni 'dri bar byed/ /stong nyid gang la'ang lha med cing / /klu med srin po yong ma yin/ /mi 'am mi ma yin yang rung / /thams cad de na yong 8med do/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de nas khye'u cig shos des rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid de la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ ming ni ming gis stong pa ste/ / ming la ming ni yod ma yin/ /chos rnams thams cad ming med de 1/ /'on kyang ming gis yongs su brjod/ /ming gi rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /de ni ma mthong ma thos so/ /las kyis 'gags pa ma yin na/ /'di na gang gi ming zhig 'dri/ /tha snyad du ni ming byas nas/ /ming btags byas te bstan pa ni/ /kho bo'i ming ni rin chen sems/ /cig 1 shos rin chen mchog ces bya/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de ltar khye'u gnyis kyis tshigs su bcad pa 55—586

'di dag smras te mngon par shes pa lnga bsgrubs nas/ rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid de dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 1zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 2te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas thal mo sbyar te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de ltar khye'u de gnyis kyis dbyangs gcig tu bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ pad ma 3dag dang dri bda' cadang / /me tog phreng dang na bza' dang / /'on te zas dang skom gyis sam/ /rgyal ba 5ji ltar mchod par bgyi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso/ /ji ltar mchod par 'gyur ba lags/ /don 'di legs par bstan du gsol/ /'dren pa thos nas 'tshal bar bgyi/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgra tshobacom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas des khye'u de gnyis la tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/lus can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed na/ /mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas dag la mchod par 'gyur/ /mi gang zhig gis sangs rgyas zhing / /gang gā'i bye ma'i grangs snyed dag /me tog rnams kyis bkang byas te/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis 'dir ni thal /sbyar nas/ /byang chub tu ni sems btud na/ /'di ni bsod nams ches mang ste/ /de la tshad ni yod ma yin/ /byang chub sems ni ci 'dra bske/ /de ltar blo mchog gis bstan pa/ /de 'dra'i mchod pa gang yang med/ /de 'dra ba 9yi dpal yang med/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de ltar khye'u de 55—587

gnyis kyis slar yang bcom ldan 'das de la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/'jig rten mgon po'i spyan sngar ni/ /bdag cag yi dam yang dag 'cha'1/ /bla na med pa'i seng ge'i sgra/ /lha dang mi dag gsan mdzod cig /ji srid du ni 'khor ba yi/ /sngon gyi mtha' ni mi dmigs pa/ /de srid bskal pa du mar yang ske/ /sems can phyir ni spyad par bgyi/ /ji tsam sngon gyi mtha' dran pa/ /rnam grangs 'di yi tshul dag gis/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /de srid bskal par spyad par bgyi/ /gal te de ring slan chad du/ /'dod chags kyi ni sems 'byung na / /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bslus par 'gyur/ /de ltar zhe sdang gti mug dang / /phrag dog ser sna'ang de bzhin no/ /rtag tu bden pa'i tshig smra zhing / /brdzun cagyi tshig ni spang bar bgyi/ /gal te de ring slan chad du/ /rdul med byang chub ma thob par / /bdag cag nyan thos sems gyur pa/ /des ni brdzun du smra bar 'gyur/ / nams kyang parang sangs rgyas su ni/ /bdag cag dga' bar mi bgyid de/ /sems can rnams la snying rje zhing / /bskal pa bye bar spyad par bgyi/ /ji ltar 'dren pa khyod kyi zhing / /grub pa rnam pa 'di tshodag las/ /gzhan du yon tan bye ba snyed/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing du bgyi / /de na nyan thos gang yang med / /rang rgyal 'dren pa dag kyang med/ /de tshe bye 8ba tshad med pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig 9gnas/ /bde ba 'di dang ldan pa yi/ /skye bo dri ma med par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mdzod ni bzung bas 1 na/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams tshar phyin to/ /gal te 'di dag gzhan min par/ /de bzhin du ni 'gyur nges na/ /rgya mtshor bcas dang rir bcas pa'i/ /sa 'di thams 55—588

cad g.yos par shog /tshig 'di smras pa'i mod la ni/ /sa yang rab tu g.yos par gyur/ /sil snyan dag ni ma dkrol bar/ /de na thams cad sgra yang 'byin//stong phrag bye ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /me tog char dang phye 1ma'i char/ /spos kyi char ni yid 'ong dang / /na bza' bye ba rab tu phab/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid ces bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du dogs sam yid gnyis za na de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid ces bya bar gyur to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de'i tshe de'i dus na khye'u rin chen sems dang / rin chen mchog ces bya ba de gnyis gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du 'dzin na de yang de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'di ni khye'u rin chen mchog ces bya bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po namathu chen thob 'di ni khye'u rin chen sems zhes bya bar gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di gnyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu dang po sems bskyed pa ni de yin no/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis ji tsam du zab mo la mos pa lagyur pa dang / gang gi ming yang ma 5dmigs pa de srid du 'di gnyis byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur ( pa ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das la skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de'i pha rol na sangs rgyas 55—589

ji snyed cig la rim 1gro bgyis par gyur// bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi 3bu gang gā'i klung gi bye ma ni bgrang bas mtha' rtogs par nus kyi/ skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis kyis de bzhin gshegs pa de'i pha rol na sangs rgyas dag la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag ni de lta 4ma yin te/ de srid du 'di gnyis kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i go cha bgos shing yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan te/ 'di gnyis kyi yon tan dag gi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'jig rten gyi khams yon tan rin chen bsags pa dpag tu med pa bde ba kun tu ston pa zhes bgyi ba de dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po zhes bgyi ba gang lags pa de 'di nas phyogs gang logs na mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu nub phyogs logs na ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can de nyid de'i tshe de'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan rin chen bsags pa dpag tu med pa bde ba kun tu ston pa zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che dang /lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / sman pa dang bde bar bgyi ba'i slad du skyes bu dam pa de gnyis kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa ci 'dra bar 'gyur 55—590

ba dang / nyan thos phun sum tshogs pa ci 'dra ba dang / tshe ji tsam pa dang /longs spyod ci 'dra ba dang / 'od ci 'dra ba dang / skyes bu dam pa de gnyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas mtshan ji skad ces bgyi ba de dag legs par bstan du gsol/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pas skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis kyi smon lam chen po bshad pa thos nas byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag kyang smon lam chen po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba'i slad du'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig 1dang bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes bya ba gsol te rna/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces 3bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi tshe'i tshad ni dpag tu med de/ de'i mtha' ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi bar du bshad kyang rtogs par sla ba ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa 4'od dpag med kyi tshe dpag tu med du zin kyang 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa / mi brtan pa/ ther zug ma yin pa/ yun du gnas pa ma yin pa 7ste/ rigs kyi bu ma 'ongs pa'i dus 'das pa de'i tshe de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med de yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar ri'agyur ro/ /de yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag 55—591

brgyad cu 1rtsa bzhi'i bar du de'i dam pa'i chos gnas te/ ji ltar bzhugs pa de bzhin du yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'grub ste/ lhag chad med par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan du na sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa de mthong ba med par zad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur/de dag rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad 2par sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'od dpag med yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas 3kyang rin po che sna bdun gyi pad ma dag dang shing ljon pa dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa de ji ltar chos ston pa de bzhin du pad ma dag dang shing ljon pa de dag las 4kyang chos kyi sgo brgya phrag du ma 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas dam pa'i chos nub ma thag pa'i mtshan mo skya rengs snye 'char ba'i dus kyi tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rin po che du ma'i bkod pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung du 'dug nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 6'tshang rgya'o/ /de mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod par 'gyur ba gang yin pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du bstan kyang mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i bde ba'i rgyu dang yon tan gyi rgyu ni de snyed du 'gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang 55—592

rigs kyi bu dpe tsam du cung zad cig bshad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing na yon tan bkod pa gang dag yod pa yon tan gyi bkod pa snga ma dag ni yon tan bkod pa 'di dag gi brgya'i char yang mi chog /stong gi cha dang /brgya stong gi cha dang / grangs dang / dpe dang / rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na 1nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ming yang med par 'gyur ten/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni byang chub sems dpa' 'ba' zhig gis gang bar 4'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu da ltar bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed pa de dag thams cad bsdus kyang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po de'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi brgya'i char yang mi chog ste/ stong gi cha dang / brgya stong gi cha dang / grangs dang / dpe dang / rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /de'i tshe tshad 5ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug tu 'gyur ro/ /de'i dam pa'i chos ni bskal pa bye ba drug cu rtsa gsum du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams de'i ming yang bde ba can zhes bgyi bar 'gyur ram/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de ni ma yin te/ 'jig rten gyi khams de ni rin chen kun nas bsags pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po'i tshe 55—593

ji srid gnas pa nas bzung ste/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de srid du byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang de'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin par 'gyur te/ dam pa'i chos yun ring por gnas par bya ba'i phyir spro bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi ma'i dus su der dam pa'i chos nub nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing der bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rigs 1pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs 2pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das yon tan shin tu gnas pa nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po de'i byang chub sems dpa' phun sum tshogs pa dang / snang ba phun sum tshogs pa ci 'dra ba de ltar/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan shin tu gnas pa nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po de'i yang de dang 'dra bar 'gyur te/ lhag chad med cing shin tu lhag pa med par 'gyur ro/ /tshe'i yun dang dam pa'i chos gnas pa yang de srid du 'gyur ro / /rigs kyi bu dang rigs kyi bu mo gang la la dag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po de dang /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan shin tu gnas pa nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po de'i mtshan thos pa de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag 55wa 594

par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po bud med gang la las bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de dang / ma 'ongs pa de gnyis kyi mtshan thos na de bud med kyi rang bzhin du mi 1'gyur ro/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag bzhi bcur 'khor ba bsnyil bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / chos nyan pa dang / dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur/ tshe rjes nas kyang rab tu 'byung ba 'thob par 'gyur/tshe rabs dran pa dang / spobs pa thogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyang 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'khor de'i nang nas lha dang mi dang skye dgu'i srog chags bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gis mgrin gcig tu tshig smras pa/gang dag ma byon pa de dag dang / gang dag da ltar bzhugs pa 'tsho zhing gzhes pa de dag dang / phyogs bcu na gang dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de dag gi mtshan gang lags pa de dag la yang rjes su yi rang ngo / /tshig 'di skad ces kyang smra ste// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag lhan cig tshogs pa thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /zhes smras so/ /de dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan to/ /srog chags khrag khrig brgya phrag brgyad cu /rtsa bzhi ni chos rnams la 4chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /dge slong bdun stong ni len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /55wa 595

de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthu chen thob kyis ji lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 'du byas pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyis phyogs bcu na bcom ldan 'das dpag tu med grangs med pa dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston pa mthong ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du bya ba mngon par 1byas so/ /mthong nas kyang tshig 'di skad 'dzer to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji tsam du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'di gnyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gis legs par yongs su bzung ba lags te/ 'di ltar skyes bu dam pa 'di gnyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyed cig lung ston pa ni ngo mtshar to / /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo sde zab mo 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa 2dang ske/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa de'i bsod nams ji snyed cig 'phel bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la yongs su 'dri ba'i gtam 'dis ci zhig bya/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu sems can dman pa la mos pa de dag de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa la yid mi ches par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/de ltar 'di dag yun ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa med pa dang / bde ba med pa dang / log par ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 55—596

'khor 'di na rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo dag rgya chen po la mos pa dang /mos pa mang ba dag kyang mchis/ slad ma'i skye bo rnams la yang snang ba 1bgyis par 'gyur na de bzhin gshegs pas skye bo mang po la sman pa dang / skye bo mang po 2la bde ba'i slad du bshad par gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang bshad do/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos/bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te / bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces 5bka' stsal 6to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di la mi gang la la stobs dang ldan pa/ mthu dang ldan pa/ bsod nams kyi phung po chen po dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ ji tsam sems can gyi khams su gdags pas btags 7pa'i sems can gyi khams de ni de bzhin gshegs pas ches mang bar gsungs kyi/ sa'i khams ni de lta ma yin te / sems can de dag thams cad bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas mu med par mgo bo'am/ phrag pa'am/lag pa na thogs te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du de dag la gos dang zas dag byin te/bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis rim gror byed/ bla mar byed na pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po mi de gzhi de las bsod nams kyi phung po mang du 'phel lam/gsol pa/ sems can gcig la yang se gol gtogs pa tsam zhig byams pa'i sems kyis khyab par bgyis na de tsam gyis kyang bsod nams mang du skyed 9na/bskal pa bye ba mtha' yas mu ma mchis par sems can thams cad bzung ste/bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis rim gro bgyis pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/bka' stsal pa/ pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po khyod mos par bya'o/ /khyod kyi khong 55—597

du chud par bya'o/ /gang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di byang chub kyi sems la gnas te/ len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo dad pa la zhugs pa/ mos pa mang ba dag gzhi de las bsod nams kyi phung po ches mang du skyed 1do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang bdag gis blang bar bgyi/ bzung rnabar bgyi/ bcang bar 3bgyi/bklag 4par bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan par bgyi'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying pos tshig de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gis dbyangs gcig tu tshig 'di skad ces smras so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang mdo sde 'di lta bu 'di blang bar bgyi/ bzung snye bar bgyi/ bcang bar bgyi/ bklag tshopar bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi/gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan par bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bud med kyis thos ma thag tu bud med kyi dngos po las 'gyur te/ rgyu gnyis ma gtogs pa ni 'di lta ste/ phrag dog dang / ser sna'o/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / mi mjed 7kyi bdag po tshangs pa dang / rgyal po chen po 55—598

bzhi dang / lha'i bu brgya stong du ma dag gis lha'i me tog man dā 1ra ba dag bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag la mngon par gtor to/ /lha'i 5sil snyan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gsil nas tshig 'di skad ces kyang 'dzer to/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gang dag gi rna lam du grag pa dag legs par bton nas 'dzin pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa'i sems can de dag gis ni rnyed pa legs par rnyed pa lags so / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag ji skad smras pa de de bzhin te/ chos kyi rnam ci grangs 'di gang dag gi lag na 'dug pa dang / gang dag thos nas mos par 'gyur ba'i sems can de dag ni sangs rgyas khri la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed tshopar 'gyur/ de nas sring mo rdul dang bral ba zhes bya ba/ 'khor der 'dus par gyur te/ 'dug pa de/ stan las langs nas lhag pa'i bsam pas tshig 'di skad ces/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang lhag pa'i bsam pas phrag dog dang / ser sna spangs te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ni mad 8pa gsung ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag sangs rgyas su 'gyur zhing bud med gzhan gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos na thos pa'i mod la bud med kyi dngos po las 'gyur ba lta na/ bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du/ phung po 'di nyid la bud med kyi dbang po mi gda' bar 'gyur te/ skyes pa'i dbang po byung bar gyur cig ces smras so/ /de nas sring mo de de nyid du bud med kyi dbang po mi snang bar gyur te skyes pa'i dbang po byung bar gyur to/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das 55wa 599

kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog cing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyon mongs pa thams cad zlog pa zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad ma'i dpal gyi snying po dang / dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' mang po de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang /dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi 1rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin zhes nabya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sor// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab par// //55—600

khuzhu/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄dzi /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na mu drwa sa mā dhi nā ma ma 2hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da 3 ka'i gnas na/ dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag sum cu 4thams cad kyang gzungs thob pa/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa/ ting nge 'dzin thob pa/stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i spyod yul pa/smon lam bcos ma ma yin pa/ smon pa med pa la gnas pa/ spyod lam bcos pa med pa/ sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i gzungs thob pa/ mnyam pa nyid du 55—606

bzod pa thob pa/ mnyam pa nyid thob pa/ thogs pa med pa'i gzungs thob pa/sems can thams cad kyi dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa shes pa dang /bsam pa dang / spyod pa'i tshul shin tu shes pa sha stag dang thabs cig 1 tu bzhugs te/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 2sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gzugs med pal/ bstan du med pa/ gzung ba med pa/ thogs pa med pa/ snang ba med pa / rnam par rig pa med pa/ rnam par rig par bya ba ma yin pa/ sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa dang bral ba/ rtsa ba med pa/ rten pa med pa/dmigs su med pa/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa / mnyam pa med pa/ zla med pa/ nga yi ba med pa/ yongs su 'dzin pa med pa/ mi bya ba med pa /ma byas pa/ ma song ba/ ma 'ongs pa/ 'gro ba med pa/ mi gnas pa/rgyun chad pa med pa/ gnas med pa/ mtshan ma med pa/ mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba/ blang ba med pa/ dor ba med pa/ 'dus ma byas pa/mngon par 'du mi byed pa/ 'du ba med pa/ bral ba med pa/ sems med pa / sems dang bral ba/ kun tu 'byung ba med pa/ rtsom pa med pa/yongs su grub pa med pa/ ma byung ba/ kun tu ma byung ba/ rab tu rgyu ba med pal/ yang dag par rgyu ba med pa/ shin tu stong pa/ 'dre ba med pa/ chos thams cad la sgro 8btags pa med pa 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa'i gzungs kyi sgo de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyi sku yang mi snang sku'i samatshan ma yang mi 55—607
